segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنّي أَخافُكَ ، وَأَخافُ مِمَّنْ يَخافُكَ ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِمَّنْ لايَخافُكَ .
segments.transliteration: rabbi innee maghloobun fantas'ir
segments.translation: Oâ Allah, indeed I fear You and fear those who fear You, and I seek refuge in You from those who do not fear You.

segments.transliteration: Sajadto laka Khazein Khashia Zaleel
segments.translation: âMy Lord I have been overcome, so help [me].â

segments.transliteration: Yaa Haseebo
segments.translation: I prostrate to you in humility & abjectness

segments.transliteration: Allahumma Salle al Fatima wa abeeha wa baleha wa baneeha wa sirril mustaudaeh fiha beadada maa ahaata behi ilmuk
segments.translation: O Reckoner.

segments.arabic:
اَلَّهُمَّ صَلّ عَلىٰ فَاطِمَةَ وَ اَبِيْهَا وَ بَعْلِهَا وَ بَنِيْهَا
 وَ سِرِِّ الْمُسْتَوْدِعِ فِيْهَا 
 بِعَدَدِ مَا اَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ
segments.transliteration: Laa h'awla wa laa quwwata illa billaah
segments.translation: Oh Allah send blessings on Fatima and her father, her husband and her sons, and by the secret installed in her (S)) which only is in YOUR knowledge

segments.arabic: لَاحَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: ya mud'illa kulli jabbaarin a'needin biqahrin a'z'eemin wa sult'aanihee
segments.translation: There is no power nor strength with (anyone) save Allah.

segments.arabic: يَا مُذِلَّ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيْدٍ بِقَهْرٍ عَظِيمٍ وَ سُلْطَانِهِ
segments.transliteration: yaa rabbaahu yaa rabbaahu
segments.translation: O He who disgraces all obstinate tyrants by the exercise of His supreme power and absolute authority.

segments.transliteration:
wa innahooo ahlaka a'ada nil oolaa

wa thamoods famaaa abqaa

wa qawma nooh'im min qablu innahum kaanoohum az'lama wa at'ghaa wal mootafikata ahwaa

faghashshaahaa maa ghashshaa
segments.translation: O my support in my hardship,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنَّهُ أَهْلَكَ عَادَانِ الْأَوْلَى وَ ثَمُودَا فَمَا أَبْقَى وَ قَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِنْ قَبْلُ، إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَ اطفی وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَى فَغَشْهَا مَا غَشَى
segments.transliteration: at'faytu ghaz'abaka yaa (mention enemy's name) billa illaha illallaah
segments.translation: And O my help in my distress,

segments.arabic: أَطْفَيْتُ غَضَبَكَ يَا ... بِلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ .
segments.transliteration: innee astashfi-u ilayka bi muh'ammadin wa aalihee s'allallaahu a'layhim wa' an taghlibahoo lee
segments.translation: Guard me with Your eye that never sleeps,

segments.arabic:
إِنِّي اسْتَشْفِعُ إِلَيْكَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ أَنْ تَغْلِبَهُ لِي
		  -->
segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee as-aluka bismakil makhzoonil maknoonit t'aahiril mut'ahharil mubaaraki
segments.translation: And suffice me with Your unassailable power,

segments.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ يَا حَيَا لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيْثُ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اغِثْنِي السَّاعَةَ السَّاعَةَ
segments.transliteration: wa as-aluka bismikal a'zeemi wa sultaanikal qadeemi
segments.translation: O Possessor of supreme strength,

segments.arabic: أَسْتَلْكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْ تُصَلَّى عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَنْ تَلْطُفَ لِي وَأَنْ تَغْلِبَ لِي وَأَنْ تَمَكَرَ لِي وَأَنْ تَخْدَعَ لِي وَأَنْ تَكْيدَلِي وَأَنْ تَكْفِينِي مَوْنَةً فلان بن فلان
segments.transliteration: ya waahibal a't'aayaa wa yaa mut'liqal usaaraa wa yaa fukkaakar riqaabi minan naari as-aluka
segments.translation: And O Possessor of majestic might,

segments.transliteration: an tus'alliya a'laa muh'ammadin wa aali muh'ammad wa an tukhrijanee minad dunyaa saaliman wa tudkhilanil jannata aaminan
segments.translation: And O Possessor of honor before whom all creation is humbled,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْمَخْزُوْنِ الْمَكْنُونِ الطَّاهِرِ الْمُطَهَّرِ الْمُبَارَكِ
segments.transliteration: wa an tut'liqa raqabatee minan naari
segments.translation: Send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيمِ وَ سُلْطَانِكَ الْقَدِيمِ
segments.transliteration: wa an taj-a'la du - a'a - i awwalahoo falaah'an wa awsaat'ahoo najjaah'an wa aakhirahoo s'alaah'
segments.translation: And protect me from my oppressor,

segments.arabic: يَا وَاهِبَ الْعَطَايَا وَ يَا مُطْلِقَ الْأَسَارَى وَ يَا فُكَاكَ الرِّقَابِ مِنَ النَّارِ اسْتَلُكَ
segments.transliteration: an innaka anta a'llaamul ghuyoob
segments.translation: And take vengeance for me against him.

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تُخْرِجَنِي مِنَ الدُّنْيَا سَالِمًا وَ تُدْخِلَنِي الْجَنَّةَ آمِنًا
segments.transliteration: allaahummat ruqho be-laylatin laa ukhta lahaa, wa abeh hareemahu.
segments.translation: O Sustainer, O Sustainer.

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْ تُطْلِقَ رَقَبَتِي مِنَ النَّارِ
segments.transliteration: billaahe astafteho wa billaahe astanjeho wa be-mohammadin (sallal laaho aâlayhe wa aalehi) atawajjaho. allaahumma sahhil lee hozoonata amree kullahu, wa yassir lee so-oâobatahu, innaka tamhoo maa tashaaa-o wa tusbeto, wa iândaka ummul ketaab.
segments.translation:
That He it is who destroyed the Ad of old,

And Thamud! He did not spare (them),

(like) the people of Nuh before them, who were, verily, the most unjust and the most transgressive;

And He overthrew the subverted cities,

So that they were covered by what they were covered over.

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ دُعَائِي أَوَّلَهُ فَلَاحًا وَ أَوْسَطَهُ نَجَاحًا وَآخِرَةَ صَلَاحًا
segments.transliteration: Istaslamtu mawlayya laka
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, and with Allah, and from Allah, and to Allah.

segments.transliteration: Wa aslamtu nafsi ilayka
segments.translation: And in the way of Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اطْرُقْهُ بِلَيْلَةٍ لَا اُخْتَ لَهَا، وَ اَبِحْ حَرِيْـمَهٗ.‏
segments.transliteration: Wa tawakkaltu fi kulli umuri 'alayka
segments.translation: O Allah, to You I have submitted my soul.

segments.arabic: بِاللهِ اَسْتَفْتِحُ وَ بِاللهِ اَسْتَنْجِحُ وَ بِـمُحَمَّدٍ (صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهٖ) اَتَوَجَّهُ. اَللّٰهُمَّ سَهِّلْ لِيْ حُزُوْنَةَ اَمْرِيْ كُلَّهٗ، وَ يَسِّرْ لِيْ صُعُوْبَتَهٗ؛ اِنَّكَ تَـمْحُوْ مَا تَشَآءُ وَ تُثْبِتُ، وَ عِنْدَكَ اُمُّ الْكِتَابِ.‏‏
segments.transliteration: Wa ana 'abdaka wa ibn 'abdik
segments.translation: And to You I have turned my face.

segments.transliteration: Akhbarni Allahumma fi sitrika
segments.translation: And to You I have entrusted my affairs.

segments.transliteration: 'An shirari khalqik
segments.translation: And protect me with the safeguard of faith.

segments.arabic: وَ تَوَكَّلْتُ فِي كُلِّ أُمُورِي عَلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa a'simni min kulli adhÄ wa su'
segments.translation: From before me and from behind me.

segments.arabic: وَ أَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَ ابْنُ عَبْدَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: Bimannika wa kfini sharr kulli dhÄ« sharrin
segments.translation: And from my right and from my left.

segments.transliteration: Bi qudratika
segments.translation: And from above me and below me.

segments.transliteration: Allahumma man kadani aw aradani
segments.translation: And ward off from me with Your power and strength.

segments.arabic: وَ أَعْصِمْنِي مِنْ كُلِّ أَذًى وَ سُوْءٍ
segments.transliteration: Fa inni adra'u bika fi naá¸¥rihi
segments.translation: For there is no power nor strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Great.

segments.arabic: بِمَنِّكَ وَ اكْفِنِي شَرَّ كُلِّ ذِي شَرٍّ
segments.transliteration: Wa asta'inu bika minhu
segments.translation: I make cool your anger O (mention enemys name) with (the help of) ;there is no god save Allah.

segments.transliteration: Wa asta'idu minhu bihawlika wa quwatika
segments.translation: I have quenched your anger, O... There is no god but Allah.

segments.transliteration: Wa shudd 'anni aydi al-zalimeen
segments.translation: Verily, I entreat you in the name of Muhammad and his children (send blessings on them) and overpower him (my enemy) for my sake.

segments.transliteration: Idh kunta nasiri
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the best of names.

segments.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Lord of the earth and the heavens.

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْتَعِيذُ مِنْهُ بِحَوْلِكَ وَ قُوَّتِكَ
segments.transliteration: Ya Arham al-Rahimeen
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, by whose name neither poison nor disease can harm.

segments.transliteration: Wa ilahi al-'alameen
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, I begin my morning and upon Allah I rely.

segments.transliteration: As'aluka kifayata al-adha
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, over my heart and soul.

segments.transliteration: Wa al-afiyah wa al-shifa'
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, over my religion and intellect.

segments.transliteration: Wa al-nasr 'ala al-a'da'
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, over my family and wealth.

segments.transliteration: Wa al-tawfiq lima tuhibb
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, over what my Lord has granted me.

segments.transliteration: RabbanÄ wa tardÄ
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, by whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

segments.transliteration: Ya ilaha al-'alameen
segments.translation: Allah, Allah is my Lord. I associate nothing with Him.

segments.transliteration: Ya Jabbar al-samawat wa al-aradeen
segments.translation: Allah is the Greatest. Allah is Greater, Mightier, and more Glorious than what I fear or dread.

segments.transliteration: Ya Rabb Muhammad wa alihi al-tayyibin al-tahirin
segments.translation: Your support is strong, and Your praise is exalted. There is no deity but You.

segments.transliteration: Salahatu 'alayhim ajma'in
segments.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self and from the evil of every harsh authority.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma yaduka fawqa yadihi
segments.translation: And from the evil of every rebellious devil and from the evil of every stubborn tyrant.

segments.transliteration: Wa sulá¹­Änuka a'áºamu min sulá¹­Änihi
segments.translation: And from the evil of a bad decree and from every creature whose forelock You hold.

segments.arabic: يَا رَبَّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« adra'u bika fÄ« naá¸¥rihi
segments.translation: Indeed, You are on a straight path.

segments.transliteration: Wa a'Å«dhu bika min sharrihi
segments.translation: And You are the Guardian over everything.

segments.transliteration: Wa ast'aÄ«nÅ« bika 'alayhi
segments.translation: Indeed, my Guardian is Allah who revealed the Book, and He is the Protector of the righteous.

segments.transliteration: Wa al-jÄ'u ilayka mimmÄ ashfaqtu 'ala nafsÄ« minhu
segments.translation: So if they turn away, say: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity except Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَدْرَأُ بِكَ فِي نَحْرِهِ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma fakun 'inda áºannÄ« bika fÄ« mÄ lam ajid fÄ«hi mafza'an ghayruka
segments.translation: O my Allah, verily I beseech You in the name of Your name, well guarded and not known, pure, purifying, blessed:

segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ malja'an siwÄka
segments.translation: and again and again I beseech You in the name of Your great name and Your eternal sovereignty,

segments.transliteration: Faqad 'alimta anna 'adhlaka awsa'u min jawri al-jÄ'irÄ«n
segments.translation: O bestower of gifts, O liberator of captives, O He who saves the necks (of sinners if pardoned) from the (punishment) of fire,

segments.arabic: وَ الْجَأُ إِلَيْكَ مِمَّا أَشْفَقْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِي مِنْهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa iná¹£Äfuka min warÄ' al-áºÄlimÄ«n
segments.translation: I beseech You to send blessings on Muhammadn and on the children of Muhammad, let me depart from this world free from (obligations to my fellow beings) and enter paradise in peace and security,

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَكُنْ عِندَ ظَنِّي بِكَ فِي مَا لَمْ أَجِدْ فِيهِ مَفْزَعًا غَيْرُكَ
segments.transliteration: Fa ajirni minhu yÄ ilÄha al-'ÄlamÄ«n
segments.translation: (it is possible only if) You keep my neck safe from the fire.

segments.transliteration: Bi á¸¥aqqika 'alayya fa innÄ aá¸¥adan lÄ ya'rifu á¸¥aqqaka á¸¥asaba ma'rifatika bi á¸¥aqqika
segments.translation: Let the beginning of my prayer earn success, the middle salvation, and the end goodness.

segments.arabic: فَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ عَدْلَكَ أَوْسَعُ مِنْ جَوْرِ الْجَائِرِينَ
segments.transliteration: HasbÄ« anta yÄ AllÄh
segments.translation: Verily You are He who knows the unseen.

segments.transliteration: HasbÄ« anta yÄ AllÄh
segments.translation: O Lord, strike him with peerless misfortune in the night and allow his defenses to be ransacked.[1]

segments.transliteration: HasbÄ« anta yÄ AllÄh
segments.translation: By the help of Allah, I seek conquest, by the power of Allah, I will achieve success and through Muhammad (s.a.w.a.), I turn to (Allah). O Lord, soften for his hardheartedness all of it, and comfort me from his difficult attitue; You delete what You will, and establish. And with You there is the original book.

segments.arabic: بِحَقِّكَ عَلَيَّ فَإِنَّ أَحَدًا لَا يَعْرِفُ حَقَّكَ حَسَبَ مَعْرِفَتِكَ بِحَقِّكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa man yatawakkal 'alayka fa anta á¸¥asbuhu
segments.translation: I have surrendered, my Lord, to You

segments.transliteration: Bi dhÄlika jarÄ wa'duka
segments.translation: And I have submitted my soul to You

segments.transliteration: Wa naá¹­aqa kitÄbuka
segments.translation: And I have relied on You in all my affairs

segments.transliteration: Wa anta awfÄ al-á¸ÄminÄ«n
segments.translation: And I am Your servant, and the son of Your servant

segments.transliteration: Subá¸¥Änaka Rabbi al-'ÄlamÄ«n
segments.translation: O Allah, inform me of Your protection

segments.transliteration: Wa á¹£allÄ AllÄhu 'ala Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi
segments.translation: Against the evil of Your creatures

segments.transliteration: Hasbi al-Rabb min al-marboobin
segments.translation: And preserve me from all harm and evil

segments.transliteration: Wa hasbi al-Khaliq min al-makhluqin
segments.translation: By Your grace, protect me from the evil of every evil one

segments.transliteration: Wa hasbi al-Raziq min al-marzuqin
segments.translation: By Your power

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَلِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa hasbi Allah Rabb al-'alameen
segments.translation: O Allah, whoever plots against me or intends harm to me

segments.transliteration: Hasbi man huwa hasbi
segments.translation: Indeed, I seek refuge in You from their evil

segments.transliteration: Hasbi man lam yazal
segments.translation: And I seek assistance from You against him

segments.transliteration: Hasbi Allah
segments.translation: And I seek refuge from him with Your power and strength

segments.transliteration: La ilaha illa huwa
segments.translation: And repel the hands of the oppressors from me

segments.transliteration: Alayhi tawakkaltu
segments.translation: If You are my supporter

segments.transliteration: Wa huwa Rabb al-'arsh al-'azim
segments.translation: There is no god but You

segments.transliteration: Allahumma tummahu bil-bala'i tumma
segments.translation: O Most Merciful of the merciful

segments.transliteration: Wa ghummahu bil-bala'i ghamma
segments.translation: And God of all the worlds

segments.transliteration: Wa qummahu bil-adha qamma
segments.translation: I ask You for sufficiency from harm

segments.transliteration: Wa irmih biyawmin la ma'ada lahu
segments.translation: And for health and healing

segments.transliteration: Wa sa'atin la marda laha
segments.translation: And victory over the enemies

segments.transliteration: Wa abih harimahu
segments.translation: And success in what You love

segments.transliteration: Wa salli 'ala Muhammad wa ahl baytihi
segments.translation: O our Lord, and to please You

segments.arabic: وَ ارْمِه بِيَوْمٍ لَا مَعَادَ لَهُ
segments.transliteration: (âAlayhi wa 'alayhim al-salam)
segments.translation: O God of all the worlds

segments.transliteration: Wa qini sharrah
segments.translation: O Compeller of the heavens and the earth

segments.transliteration: Wa kfini amrah
segments.translation: O Lord of Muhammad and his pure, clean family

segments.arabic: وَ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa asrif 'anni kaydah
segments.translation: Your blessings upon them all

segments.transliteration: Wa ahrij qalbah
segments.translation: O Allah, Your hand is above his hand

segments.transliteration: Wa sudda fa'hu 'anni
segments.translation: And Your authority is greater than his authority

segments.transliteration: "Wa khash'at al-aswat lil-Rahman"
segments.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from him

segments.transliteration: "Fala tasma'u illa hamsan"
segments.translation: And I seek refuge in You from his evil

segments.transliteration: "Wa 'anatil wujuhu lil-Hayy al-Qayyum"
segments.translation: And I seek Your assistance against him

segments.transliteration: "Wa qad khaba man hamala dhulmÄ"
segments.translation: And I turn to You for refuge in what I fear for myself from him

segments.transliteration: "Ikhsa'u fiha wa la tukallimun"
segments.translation: O Allah, be for me according to my expectation of You in that from which I found no refuge other than You

segments.transliteration: Sah sah sah sah sah sah sah
segments.translation: And no sanctuary besides You

segments.transliteration: BismillÄhir-Raá¸¥mÄnir-Raá¸¥Ä«m
segments.translation: For You know that Your justice is wider than the oppression of the oppressors

segments.transliteration: Inna Rabbakum lar'Å«fun raá¸¥Ä«m
segments.translation: And Your fairness from behind the wrongdoers

segments.transliteration: AlÄ inna khayra 'ibÄdi AllÄh at-taqÄ«yu al-khafÄ«
segments.translation: So protect me from him, O Lord of the worlds

segments.arabic: صَهْ صَهْ صَهْ صَهْ صَهْ صَهْ صَهْ
segments.transliteration: Wa inna sharra 'ibÄdi AllÄh al-mushÄru ilayhi bil-aá¹£Äbi'a
segments.translation: By Your right over me, for indeed no one knows Your right as You know it

segments.transliteration: Wa al-á¸¥amdu lillÄhi kamÄ yanbaghÄ« lillÄh
segments.translation: Sufficient for me is You, O Allah

segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ á¸¥awla wa lÄ quwwata illÄ billÄh
segments.translation: Sufficient for me is You, O Allah

segments.arabic: أَلَا إِنَّ خَيْرَ عِبَادِ اللَّهِ التَّقِيُّ الْـخَفِيُّ
segments.transliteration: Wa á¹£allÄ AllÄhu 'ala Muá¸¥ammadin wa ahl baytihi
segments.translation: Sufficient for me is You, O Allah

segments.arabic: وَ إِنَّ شَرَّ عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الْمُشَارُ إِلَيْهِ بِالْأَصَابِعِ
segments.transliteration: An-Nabiyy al-'Arabiyy al-HÄshimÄ«
segments.translation: And whoever relies upon You, You are sufficient for him

segments.arabic: وَ الْـحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa á¹£allÄ AllÄhu 'ala jamÄ«' al-mursalÄ«n wa an-NabiyyÄ«n
segments.translation: With that, Your promise runs

segments.arabic: وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: á¸¤attÄ yará¸Ä AllÄh
segments.translation: And Your Book speaks

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
segments.transliteration: Yaa Haseebo
segments.translation: And You are the most trustworthy of those who guarantee.

segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee a-o'od'u bika min an uz'lama fee sultaanika
segments.translation: You are exalted, O Lord of the worlds

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى جَمِيعِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَ النَّبِيِّيْنَ
segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee a-o'od'u bika an az'illa hudaaka
segments.translation: And may Allah send blessings upon Muhammad and his family.

segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee a-o'o'd'u bika an aftaqira fee ghinaaka
segments.translation: My Lord is sufficient for me among those who are created

segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee a-o'od'u bika an uz'ayya-a fee salaamatika
segments.translation: And the Creator is sufficient for me among the created

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنّي أَخافُكَ ، وَأَخافُ مِمَّنْ يَخافُكَ ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِمَّنْ لايَخافُكَ .
segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee a-o'od'u bika an ughlaba wal amru laka wa ilayka
segments.translation: And the Provider is sufficient for me among those who are provided for

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ احْجُبْني عَنْ عُيُونِ أَعْدائي ، وَاجْمَعْ بَيْني وَبَيْنَ أَوْلِيائي ، وَأَنْجِزْ لي ما وَعَدْتَني ، وَاحْفَظْني في غَيْبَتي إِلى أَنْ تَأْذَنَ لي في ظُهُوري ، وَأَحْيِ بي ما دَرَسَ مِنْ فُرُوضِكَ وَسُنَنِكَ ، وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجي ، وَسَهِّلْ مَخْرَجي .
segments.transliteration: Bismillaahir rahâmaanir rahâeem. Wa laa hâaula wa laa quwwata illaa billaahil aâleeyil aâzâeem. Allaahumma iyyaaka naâbudu wa iyyaaka nastaeâeân.
segments.translation: And Allah is sufficient for me, Lord of the worlds

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ لي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطاناً نَصيراً ، وَافْتَحْ لي فَتْحاً مُبيناً ، وَاهْدِني صِراطاً مُسْتَقيماً ، وَقِني جَميعَ ما اُحاذِرُهُ مِنَ الظَّالِمينَ ، وَاحْجُبْني عَنْ أَعْيُنِ الْباغِضينَ ، اَلنَّاصِبينَ الْعَداوَةَ لِأَهْلِ بَيْتِ نَبِيِّكَ ، وَلايَصِلْ مِنْهُمْ إِلَيَّ أَحَدٌ بِسُوءٍ .
segments.transliteration: yaa allaahu yaa rahâmaanu yaa rahâeemu yaa ahâadu yaa sâamadu yaa ilaaha muhâammadin
segments.translation: Sufficient is He who is my sufficiency

segments.arabic: فَإِذا أَذِنْتَ في ظُهُوري فَأَيِّدْني بِجُنُودِكَ ، وَاجْعَلْ مَنْ يَتَّبِعُني لِنُصْرَةِ دينِكَ مُؤَيَّدينَ، وَفي سَبيلِكَ مُجاهِدينَ، وَعَلى مَنْ أَرادَني وَأَرادَهُمْ بِسُوءٍ مَنْصُورينَ، وَوَفِّقْني لِإِقامَةِ حُدُودِكَ، وَانْصُرْني عَلى مَنْ تَعَدَّى مَحْدُودَكَ.
segments.transliteration: ilaika nuqilatil aqdaamu wa afazâatil quloobu wa shakhasâatil absâaaru wa muddatil aaânaaqu wa tâulbatil hâawaa-iju wa rufiaâtil aidee
segments.translation: Sufficient is He who has always been

segments.arabic: وَانْصُرِ الْحَقَّ ، وَأَزْهِقِ الْباطِلَ ، إِنَّ الْباطِلَ كانَ زَهُوقاً ، وَأَوْرِدْ عَلَيَّ مِنْ شيعَتي وَأَنْصاري مَنْ تَقَِرُّ بِهِمُ الْعَيْنُ ، وَيَشُدُّ بِهِمُ الْأَزْرُ ، وَاجْعَلْهُمْ في حِرْزِكَ وَأَمْنِكَ ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ يا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمينَ .
segments.transliteration: allaahummaftahâ bainanaa wa baina qauminaa bil hâaqqi wa anta khairul faatihâeen.
segments.translation: Allah is sufficient for me

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ اِنِّىْ اَعُذُبِكَ مِنْ اَنْ اُضَامَ فِىْ سُلْطَانِك
segments.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wallaahu Akbar.
segments.translation: There is no deity except Him

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ اِنِّىْ اَعُذُبِكَ اَنْ اَضِلَّ هُدَاكَ
segments.transliteration: Allahumma bika astaftihu wa bika astanjihu
segments.translation: Upon Him I have placed my trust

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ اِنِّىْ اَعُذُبِكَ اَنْ اَفْتَقِرَ فِىْ غِنَاكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa bimuhammadin salla Allah 'alayh wa alihi, atawajjahu
segments.translation: And He is the Lord of the mighty Throne

segments.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك أن أضيع في سلامتك،
segments.transliteration: Allahumma sahhil li huzunatahu wa kulla huzunah
segments.translation: O Allah, overwhelm him with affliction greatly

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ اِنِّىْ اَعُذُبِكَ اَنْ اُغْلَبَ وَالْاَمْرُ لَكَ وَاِلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: Wa dhallil li su'ubatuhu wa kulla su'ubah
segments.translation: And envelop him in distress profoundly

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ. وَ لاَ حَوْلَ وَ لاَ قُوَّةَ اِلاَّ بِاللهِ الْعَلِیِّ الْعَظِيْمِ اَللَّهُمَّ اِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَ اِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِيْنُ
segments.transliteration: Wa ikfini ma'oonatahu wa kulla ma'oonah
segments.translation: And raise him with harm greatly

segments.arabic: يَا اَللهُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا رَحِيْمُ يَا اَحَدُ يَا صَمَدُ يَا اِلٰهَ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: Wa rizuqni ma'rufahu wa wuddahu
segments.translation: And cast him on a day that has no returns

segments.arabic: اِلَيْك نُقِلَتِ اْلاَقْدَامُ وَ اَفَضَتِ الْقُلُوْبُ وَ شَخَصَتِ اْلاَبْصَارُ وَ مُدَّتِ اْلاَعْنَاقُ وَ طُلِبَتِ الْحَوَآئِجُ وَ رُفِعَتِ اْلاَيْدِیْ
segments.transliteration: Wa isrif 'anni dhurruhu wa ma'aratah
segments.translation: And at an hour that cannot be reversed

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَ بَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَ اَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِيْنَ.
segments.transliteration: Innaka tamhu ma tasha'u wa tuthbit
segments.translation: And grant me access to his sanctuary

segments.arabic: لاَ اِلٰهَ اِلاَّ اللهُ وَ اللهُ اَكْبَرُ.
segments.transliteration: Wa 'indaka ummu al-kitab
segments.translation: And send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

segments.arabic:
اللَّهُمَّ إِلَيْكَ أَفْضَتِ الْقُلُوبُ، وَمُدَّتِ الأَعْنَاقُ، وَشَخَصَتِ الأَبْصَارُ، وَنُقِلَتِ الأَقْدَامُ، وَأُنْضِيَتِ الأَبْدَانُ.
اللَّهُمَّ قَدْ صَرَّحَ مَكْنُونُ الشَّنَآنِ،  وَجَاشَتْ مَرَاجِلُ الأَضْغَانِ،
segments.transliteration: Ala inna awliyaa' Allah, la khawfun 'alayhim wa la hum yahzanun
segments.translation: (peace be upon him and them)

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَشْكُو إِلَيْكَ غَيْبَةَ نَبِيِّنَا،  وَكَثْرَةَ عَدُوِّنَا، وَتَشَتُّتَ أَهْوَائِنَا،
segments.transliteration: Inna rusulu rabbika lan yasalu ilayk
segments.translation: And protect me from his evil

segments.arabic: رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْـحَقِّ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ.
segments.transliteration: Ta-ha Haam la yubsirun
segments.translation: And suffice me regarding his matter

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بِكَ اَسْتَفْتِحُ وَ بِكَ اَستَنْجِحُ
segments.transliteration: Wa ja'alna min bayni aaydeehim sadda wa min khalfihim sadda
segments.translation: And turn away his plot from me

segments.arabic: و بِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ الِهِ، اَتَوَجَّهُ
segments.transliteration: Fa aghshaynahum fahum la yubsirun
segments.translation: And embarrass his heart

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ سَهِّلْ لي حُزُونَتَهُ وَ كُلَّ حُزُونَةٍ
segments.transliteration: Ulaa'ika allatheena ataba'a Allah 'ala quloobihim wa sam'ihim wa absarihim
segments.translation: And seal his mouth against me

segments.arabic: و ذَلِّلْ لي صُعُوبَتَهُ وَ كُلَّ صُعُوبَةٍ
segments.transliteration: Wa ulaa'ika humu al-ghafiloon
segments.translation: "And the voices are humbled before the Most Merciful"

segments.arabic: و اكْفِني مَؤُونَتَهُ وَ كُلَّ مَؤُونَةٍ
segments.transliteration: Lajara ma annallaha ya'lam ma yusirrun wa ma yu'linun
segments.translation: "So you will not hear anything but whispers"

segments.transliteration: Fasaya kfika humu Allahu wa huwa as-sami'u al-'aleem
segments.translation: "And the faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Sustainer"

segments.arabic: و اصْرِفْ عَنّي ضُرَّهُ وَ مَعَرَّتَهُ
segments.transliteration: Wa tarayhum yanzuroona ilayka wa hum la yubsirun
segments.translation: "And severely failed is he who carries oppression"

segments.arabic: اِنَّكَ تَمْحُو ما تَشاءُ وَ تُثْبِتُ
segments.transliteration: Summum bukmum 'umyun fahum la yarji'un
segments.translation: "Be humiliated therein, and do not speak"

segments.transliteration: Ta-Sin, tilka ayatu al-kitab al-mubin
segments.translation: Silence, silence, silence, silence, silence, silence

segments.arabic: اَلا اِنَّ اَوْلِياءَ اللَّهِ لا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ لا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
segments.transliteration: La'allaka bakh'ihun nafsaka alla yakunoo mu'mineen
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

segments.arabic: اِنَّا رُسُلُ ربِّكَ لَنْ يَصِلُوا اِلَيْكَ
segments.transliteration: In nasha' nunazzil 'alayhim min as-samai ayah
segments.translation: Indeed, your Lord is Most Kind, Most Merciful

segments.transliteration: Fazallat a'naquhum laha khadi'een
segments.translation: Indeed, the best of Allah's servants is the God-fearing, the hidden (who acts with sincerity)

segments.arabic: و جَعَلْنا مِنْ بَيْنِ اَيْديهِمْ سَدّاً وَ مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدّاً
segments.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka bil-'ayn al-lati la t-nam
segments.translation: And indeed, the worst of Allah's servants is the one pointed at with fingers (for his wrongdoing).

segments.transliteration: Wa bil'izzi allathee la yuramu
segments.translation: And all praise is due to Allah as is befitting for Him

segments.arabic: اُولئِكَ الَّذينَ طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلى قُلُوبِهِمْ وَ سَمْعِهِمْ وَ اَبْصارِهِمْ
segments.transliteration: Wa bil-mulk allathee la yudham
segments.translation: And there is no power and no strength except with Allah

segments.transliteration: Wa bin-noor allathee la yutfa
segments.translation: And may Allah send blessings upon Muhammad and his household

segments.arabic: لاجَرَمَ اَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ ما يُسِرُّونَ وَ ما يُعْلِنُونَ
segments.transliteration: Wa bil-wajhi allathee la yabl
segments.translation: The Arab Prophet, the Hashemite

segments.arabic: فَسَيَكْفيكَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَ هُوَ السَّميعُ الْعَليمُ
segments.transliteration: Wa bil-hayaat allathee la tamoot
segments.translation: And may Allah send blessings upon all the Messengers and the Prophets

segments.arabic: و تَريهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ اِلَيْكَ وَ هُمْ لايُبْصِرُونَ
segments.transliteration: Wa bil-samadiyyah allathee la tuqhar
segments.translation: Until Allah is pleased.

segments.transliteration: Wa bil-daymuumiyyah allathee la tafna
segments.translation: O Reckoner.

segments.transliteration: Wa bil-ism allathee la yurad
segments.translation: Oâ Allah, indeed I fear You and fear those who fear You, and I seek refuge in You from those who do not fear You.

segments.arabic: لَعَلَّكَ باخِعٌ نَفْسَكَ اَلاَّ يَكُونُوا مُؤْمِنينَ
segments.transliteration: Wa bir-rubuubiyyah allathee la tustadhall
segments.translation: Oâ Allah, hide me from the eyes of my enemies, and gather me with my friends, and fulfill that which You have promised me, and protect me in my occultation until You permit me for reappearance, and revive through me those obligations and recommendations which have turned old, and hasten in my relief, and ease my exit,

segments.arabic: اِنْ نَشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ السَّماءِ ايَةً
segments.transliteration: An tusalli 'ala Muhammad wa alihi Muhammad
segments.translation: and allocate a dominating support for me from Your threshold, and help me succeed with an apparent victory, and guide me to the straight path, and protect me from all those transgressors I fear, and conceal me from the eyes of those who have grudge against me, those who hold enmity against the household of Your Prophet, and do not let anyone reach me with their wickedness;

segments.transliteration: Wa an taf'alabee kada wa kada
segments.translation: thus when you permit my reappearance, strengthen me with Your army, and support those who follow me for supporting Your religion, and those who fight in Your path, and make them victorious over those who have wicked intentions for me and for them, and help me succeed in the establishment of Your regulations, and support me against those who trespass Your boundaries,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اِنّي اَسْأَلُكَ بِالْعَيْنِ الَّتي لاتَنامُ
segments.transliteration: Wa tadhkur hajatak
segments.translation: and help the truth, and defeat the evil, indeed evil is ending, and bring near me those Shias and companions whose vision cools my eyes, and strengthen my back, and regard them in Your protection and safety, with Your mercy, Oâ the most Merciful of the merciful. [1]

segments.transliteration: Allahumma bika usaawiru, wa bika uhawilu
segments.translation: O Allah, I take refuge with You for the reason that: Would I be persecuted inspite of Your absolute sovereignty?

segments.transliteration: Wa bika asulu, wa bika antasir
segments.translation: O Allah, I take refuge with You for the reason that: Would I go astray inspite of Your guidance?

segments.transliteration: Wa bika amutu wa bika ahya
segments.translation: O Allah, I take refuge with You for the reason that: Would I be deprived inspite of your abundance

segments.transliteration: Aslamtu nafsi ilayka,
segments.translation: O Allah, I take refuge with You for the reason that: Would I be ruined inspite of Your security?

segments.transliteration: Wa fawwadt 'amri ilayka
segments.translation: O Allah, I take refuge with You fro the reason that: Would I be overpowered, inspite of the fact that occurrence of every affair is on account of You and (it turns back) in the direction of You.

segments.transliteration: Wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al-âaliyy al-âazeem
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. And there is no strength or power except with Allah, the Great and High. O Allah we worship You and from You only we seek help.

segments.transliteration: Allahumma innaka khalaqtani wa razaqtani
segments.translation: O Allah! O Merciful! O Compassionate! O the one! O the self-sufficient! O God of Muhammad! (Peace of Allah be on him and his progeny).

segments.transliteration: Wa sarartani wa satartani
segments.translation: In Your domain feet are moving ahead and with the presence of heart, eyes are awaiting, necks are stretched high, where desires are asked and hands are lifted.

segments.transliteration: Wa bayna al-âibad bil-lutfi ka khawaltani
segments.translation: O Allah! You judge between us and our nation with truth, as You are the best of the judges.

segments.arabic: اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ الِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: Idha hawaaytu radadtani
segments.translation: There is no god except Allah and Allah is great.

segments.arabic: و اَنْ تَفْعَلَ بي كَذا و كَذا.
segments.transliteration: Wa idha 'athartu aqaltani
segments.translation: O Allah! My heart is present in Your Domain and the head is lowed down and eyes are fixed at You, feet are trembling and the body has become weak, old enmities are manifested; pots of malice are boiling out.

segments.transliteration: Wa idha maridtu shafaytani
segments.translation: O Allah! I complain to You of the departure of our Prophet and the abundance of the enemies, and the colourful desires.

segments.transliteration: Wa idha da'awtuka ajabtani
segments.translation: O Allah! Grant truth a victory between me and my enemies, as You are the best of those who bestow victory.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بِكَ اُساوِرُ، وَ بِكَ اُحاوِلُ
segments.transliteration: Ya sayyidi ardi 'anni
segments.translation: O Allah, by You I seek victory and by You I seek success.

segments.arabic: و بِكَ اَصُولُ، وَ بِكَ اَنْتَصِرُ
segments.transliteration: Faqad ardaytani
segments.translation: And by Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family, I direct myself.

segments.arabic: و بِكَ اَمُوتُ وَ بِكَ اَحْيا
segments.transliteration: Allahumma innal fulana bna fulan zalamani, wa iâtada âalayya, wa nasaba li, wa amadda ni wa aramada ni wa adhallani wa akhlaqani
segments.translation: O Allah, make easy for me his worries and every worry.

segments.transliteration: Allahumma fakilhu ila nafsihi
segments.translation: And alleviate for me his difficulties and every difficulty.

segments.transliteration: Wa hudd raknahu, wa ajjil jaâihatuhu
segments.translation: And suffice me against his burdens and every burden.

segments.arabic: و لاحَوْلَ وَ لاقُوَّةَ اِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظيمِ
segments.transliteration: Wa aslubhu niâmataka âindahu, wa aqtaâ rizqahu, wa abtur âumruhu
segments.translation: And bestow upon me his kindness and affection.

segments.transliteration: Wa imhu atharahu, wa sallit âalayhi âaduwwahu
segments.translation: And turn away from me his harm and disgrace.

segments.transliteration: Wa khudhhu fi maâmanihi, kama zalamani wa iâtada âalayya, wa nasaba li, wa amadda wa aramada, wa adhalla wa akhlaqa
segments.translation: Indeed, You erase what You will and confirm.

segments.transliteration: Allahumma inni astaâidu bika âala fulan ibn fulan faâaâidhni
segments.translation: And with You is the Mother of the Book.

segments.transliteration: Fa innaka ashaddu baâsan wa ashaddu tanqeela
segments.translation: Indeed, the allies of Allah have no fear upon them and they will not grieve.

segments.transliteration: Fa innahu la yumhil in shaâa Allah ØªØ¹Ø§ÙÙ, yafâal dhalika thalathan
segments.translation: Indeed, the messengers of Your Lord will not reach you.

segments.transliteration: Allahumma innaka sallata âalayna bidhunubina man la yaârifuka
segments.translation: Ta-Ha, they do not see.

segments.transliteration: Fabihuqooq man yaârifuka âalayka an tadfaâa âanna balyyata man la yaârifuka
segments.translation: And We placed before them a barrier and behind them a barrier.

segments.transliteration: Du'ahu fi al-ihtiraz
segments.translation: So We covered them, and they do not see.

segments.transliteration: Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim,
segments.translation: Those are the ones whom Allah has sealed their hearts, hearing, and sight.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اِنَّ فُلانَ بْنَ فُلانٍ ظَلَمَني، وَ اعْتَدى عَلَيَّ، وَ نَصَبَ لي، وَ اَمَضَّني وَ اَرْمَضَني وَ اَذَلَّني وَ اَخْلَقَني
segments.transliteration: Bismillah wa billah,
segments.translation: And those are the heedless.

segments.transliteration: Rabbi ihtiraztu bika, wa tawakkaltu 'alayka, wa fawwadt 'amri ilayka,
segments.translation: Without a doubt, Allah knows what they conceal and what they announce.

segments.arabic: وَ هُدَّ رَكْنَهُ، وَ عَجِّلْ جائِحَتَهُ
segments.transliteration: Rabbi al-ja'tu da'fa rukni ila quwwat ruknik,
segments.translation: So Allah will suffice you against them, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

segments.arabic: وَ اسْلُبْهُ نِعْمَتَكَ عِنْدَهُ، وَ اقْطَعْ رِزْقَهُ، وَ ابْتُرْ عُمْرَهُ
segments.transliteration: Musta'jiran bika, mustansiran laka, musta'ina bika 'ala dhawi al-ta'azzuz 'alayya wa al-qahr li wa al-quwwa 'ala dhaymi wa al-aqdam 'ala zulmi,
segments.translation: And you see them looking at you, yet they do not see.

segments.arabic: وَ امْحُ اَثَرَهُ، وَ سَلِّطْ عَلَيْهِ عَدُوَّهُ
segments.transliteration: Ya Rabbi inni fi jawarika fa innahu la dhayma 'ala jarika.
segments.translation: Deaf, dumb, and blind; they do not return.

segments.arabic: وَ خُذْهُ في مَأْمَنِهِ، كَما ظَلَمَني وَ اعْتَدى عَلَيَّ، وَ نَصَبَ لي، وَ اَمَضَّ وَ اَرْمَضَ، وَ اَذَلَّ وَ اَخْلَقَ
segments.transliteration: Rabbi faqhar 'anni qahiri bi quwwatika,
segments.translation: Ta-Sin, these are the verses of the clear Book.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اِنّي اَسْتَعيذُ بِكَ عَلى فُلانِ بْنِ فُلانٍ فَاَعِذْني
segments.transliteration: Wa awhin 'anni mustawahini bi qudratika,
segments.translation: Perhaps you will kill yourself with grief over their disbelief.

segments.arabic: فَاِنَّكَ اَشَدُّ بَأْساً وَ اَشَدُّ تَنْكيلاً
segments.transliteration: Wa aqsim 'anni dhaymi bi batshika,
segments.translation: If We will, We can send down to them a sign from the heaven.

segments.arabic: فانه لايمهل ان شاء الله تعالى، يفعل ذلك ثلاثاً
segments.transliteration: Rabbi wa a'idhni bi 'i'adhika,
segments.translation: And their necks would become humbled to it.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اِنَّكَ سَلَّطْتَ عَلَيْنا بِذُنُوبِنا مَنْ لايَعْرِفُكَ
segments.transliteration: Bika amtan'i 'aidhuka,
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask You by the eye that does not sleep.

segments.arabic: فَبِحُقُوقِ مَنْ يَعْرِفُكَ عَلَيْكَ اَنْ تَدْفَعَ عَنَّا بَلِيَّةَ مَنْ لايَعْرِفُكَ
segments.transliteration: Rabbi wa adkhil 'alayya fi dhalika kullihi sitraka,
segments.translation: And by the might that is not to be opposed.

segments.transliteration: Wa man yastatiru bika fahuwa al-amin al-mahfooz,
segments.translation: And by the sovereignty that cannot be compromised.

segments.transliteration: Wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
segments.translation: And by the light that is never extinguished.

segments.transliteration: Alhamdulillah allathee lam yattakhidh waladan wa lam yakun lahu sharik fi al-mulk,
segments.translation: And by the face that does not perish.

segments.arabic: رَبِّ احْتَرَزْتُ بِكَ، وَ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَيْكَ، وَ فَوَّضْتُ اَمْري اِلَيْكَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa lam yakun lahu waliyyun min al-zulli wa kabbirhu takbira,
segments.translation: And by the life that does not die.

segments.arabic: رَبِّ اَلْجَأْتُ ضَعْفَ رُكْني اِلى قُوَّةِ رُكْنِكَ،
segments.transliteration: Man yakun dhah heela fi nafsihi,
segments.translation: And by the absolute One who cannot be subdued.

segments.arabic: مُسْتَجيراً بِكَ، مُسْتَنْصِراً لَكَ، مُسْتَعيناً بِكَ عَلى ذَوِي التَّعَزُّزِ عَلَيَّ وَ الْقَهْرِ لي وَ الْقُوَّةِ عَلى ضَيْمي وَ الْاَقْدامِ عَلى ظُلْمِي،
segments.transliteration: Aw hawl fi taqallubihi,
segments.translation: And by the eternal existence that never fades.

segments.arabic: يا رَبِّ اِنّي في جِوارِكَ فَاِنَّهُ لاضَيْمَ عَلى جارِكَ.
segments.transliteration: Aw quwwa fi amrih,
segments.translation: And by the name that is not rejected.

segments.transliteration: Fi shay in siwa Allah 'azz wa jal,
segments.translation: And by the lordship that cannot be demeaned.

segments.transliteration: Fa-inna hawli wa quwati wa kulla heela(b)ti bi Allah al-wahid al-ahad al-samad,
segments.translation: That You send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.

segments.transliteration: Alladhi lam yalid walam yoolad walam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.
segments.translation: And that You do for me such and such.

segments.transliteration: Kullu dhi mulkin famamlukun lillah,
segments.translation: And mention your need.

segments.transliteration: Wa kulla dhi qudratin famaqdoorun lillah,
segments.translation: O Allah, by You I wrestle, and by You I strive,

segments.arabic: رَبِّ وَ اَدْخِلْ عَلَيَّ في ذلِكَ كُلِّهِ سِتْرَكَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa kulla dhÄlim fa la mahiá¹£a lahu min âadlillÄh,
segments.translation: And by You I advance, and by You I seek victory.

segments.arabic: وَ مَنْ يَسْتَتِرُ بِكَ فَهُوَ الْامِنُ الْمَحْفُوظُ،
segments.transliteration: Wa kulla mutasallit famaqhoorun lisawwati Allah,
segments.translation: And by You I die, and by You I live.

segments.arabic: و لاحَوْلَ وَ لاقُوَّةَ اِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ.
segments.transliteration: Wa kulla shay'in fa fi qabdat Allah,
segments.translation: I have surrendered my soul to You,

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَداً وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَريكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ،
segments.transliteration: Saghura kullu jabbar fi 'adhamat Allah,
segments.translation: And I have entrusted my affairs to You,

segments.arabic: وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ الذُّلِّ وَ كَبِّرْهُ تَكْبيراً،
segments.transliteration: Dhalla kullu 'anid li batsh Allah,
segments.translation: And there is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Exalted, the Great.

segments.arabic: مَنْ يَكُ ذا حيلَةٍ في نَفْسِهِ،
segments.transliteration: Istadhart 'ala kulli 'aduww,
segments.translation: O Allah, indeed You created me and provided for me,

segments.transliteration: Wa dara'tu fi nahr kulli 'aat bi Allah.
segments.translation: And You made me happy and concealed me.

segments.transliteration: Dharabtu bi idhn Allah bayni wa bayna kulli mutrafin dhi sawtatin,
segments.translation: And among the servants, by Your kindness, You granted me favor.

segments.arabic: في شَيْ ءٍ سِوَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ،
segments.transliteration: Wa jabbar dhi nakhwatin,
segments.translation: If I desired, You turned me back.

segments.arabic: فَاِنَّ حَوْلي وَ قُوَّتي وَ كُلَّ حيلَتي بِاللَّهِ الْواحِدِ الْاَحَدِ الصَّمَدِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa mutasallit dhi qudratin,
segments.translation: And if I stumble, You forgive me.

segments.arabic: الَّذي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَ لَمْ يُولَدْ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُواً اَحَدٌ.
segments.transliteration: Wa 'aat dhi muhlah,
segments.translation: And when I am sick, You heal me.

segments.transliteration: Wa walin dhi imrah,
segments.translation: And when I call upon You, You answer me.

segments.arabic: وَ كُلُّ ذي قُدْرَةٍ فَمَقْدُورٌ لِلَّهِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa hasid dhi sani'ah,
segments.translation: O my master, be pleased with me,

segments.arabic: وَ كُلِّ ظالِمٍ فَلامَحيصَ لَهُ مِنْ عَدْلِ اللَّهِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa makir dhi makidah,
segments.translation: For indeed, You have made me content.

segments.arabic: وَ كُلُّ مُتَسَلِّطٍ فَمَقْهُورٌ لِسَطْوَةِ اللَّهِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa kulla mu'anin aw mu'in 'ala maqalatin mughwiyah,
segments.translation: O Allah, indeed so-and-so, the son of so-and-so, has wronged me, and has transgressed against me, and has set up against me, and has tormented me, and has burned me, and has humiliated me, and has disgraced me.

segments.arabic: وَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ فَفي قَبْضَةِ اللَّهِ،
segments.transliteration: Aw heela mu'dhiyah,
segments.translation: O Allah, entrust him to his own self.

segments.arabic: صَغُرَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ في عَظَمَةِ اللَّهِ،
segments.transliteration: Aw siya'ah mushliyah,
segments.translation: And destroy his foundation, and hasten his calamity.

segments.transliteration: Aw ghaila muridiyah,
segments.translation: And take away Your blessing from him, and cut off his sustenance, and shorten his lifespan.

segments.transliteration: Wa kulla tagh dhi kibriyah,
segments.translation: And erase his trace, and unleash his enemy upon him.

segments.arabic: وَ دَرَأْتُ في نَحْرِ كُلِّ عاتٍ بِاللَّهِ.
segments.transliteration: Aw mu'jib dhi khuyalah 'ala kulli nafs fi kulli madhhab.
segments.translation: And take him in his place of security, just as he wronged me and transgressed against me, and set against me, and tormented me, and burned me, and humiliated me, and disgraced me.

segments.arabic: ضَرَبْتُ بِاِذْنِ اللَّهِ بَيْني وَ بَيْنَ كُلِّ مُتْرَفٍ ذي سَطْوَةٍ،
segments.transliteration: Wa a'dadtu li nafsi wa dhuriyati minhum hijaban bima anzalta fi kitabika,
segments.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from so-and-so, the son of so-and-so, so protect me.

segments.transliteration: Wa ahkamta min wahi'aka allathee la yuu'ta bi suratin min mithlihi,
segments.translation: For indeed, You are most severe in punishment and most severe in retribution.

segments.transliteration: Wa huwa al-kitab al-adl al-aziz al-jalil allathee la ya'tihi al-batil min bayna yadayhi wa min khalfi,
segments.translation: And He does not delay, if Allah wills; let him do this three times.

segments.transliteration: Tanzeelun min Hakim Majid,
segments.translation: O Allah, You have unleashed upon us due to our sins one who does not know You.

segments.transliteration: Khatama Allahu 'ala qulubihim wa 'ala sam'ihim wa 'ala absarihim ghishawah,
segments.translation: So by the rights of those who know You, it is upon You to repel from us the calamity of those who do not know You.

segments.transliteration: Wa lahum 'adhabun 'azeem,
segments.translation: His supplication for protection.

segments.transliteration: Wa salla Allah 'ala Muhammad wa alihi wa sallama tasleeman kathira.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

segments.arabic: وَ كُلِّ مُعانٍ اَوْ مُعينٍ عَلى مَقالَةٍ مُغْوِيَةٍ،
segments.transliteration: Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim,
segments.translation: In the name of Allah and by Allah,

segments.arabic: و لاتَكِلْني اِلى نَفْسي فيما حَضَرْتُهُ.
segments.transliteration: Bismillaahi wa billaahi wa minallaahi wa ilallaahi wa fee sabeelillaahi
segments.translation: He neither begets nor is born, and there is none comparable to Him.

segments.arabic: يا مَنْ لاتَنْقُصُهُ الْمَغْفِرَةُ وَ لاتَضُرُّهُ الْمَعْصِيَةُ،
segments.transliteration: allaahumma ilaika aslamtu nafsee, wa ilaika wajjahtu wajhee, wa ilaika fawwazâtu amree,
segments.translation: Thus is Allah, our Lord.

segments.transliteration: wahâfazânee bihâifzâil eemaani mim baini yadayya wa min khalfee wa aâyn yameenee wa aân shimaalee wa min fauqee wa min tahâtee
segments.translation: Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best disposer of affairs.

segments.transliteration: wadfaâ aânnee bihâaulika wa quwwatika wa laa hâaula wa laa quwwata illaa billaahil aâleeyil aâzâeem.
segments.translation: Indeed, He is Strong and a Helper.

segments.transliteration: Allaahumma adh-hib aânnee ghaizâa qalbee. Waghfirlee dhambee wa ajirnee mim mazâallaatil fitani as-aluka rizâaaka. Wa aoâoâdhubika min sakhatâika as-aluka jannatik. Wa aoâoâdhubika min naarika. Wa as-alukal khaira kulluh. Wa aoâoâdhubika minash sharri kulluh. Allaahumma thabbitnee aâlal hudaa wasâ sâawaab. Waj-aâlnee raazâiyam marzâiyan ghaira zâaallinw wa laa muzâil.
segments.translation: I seek refuge with Allah from the accursed devil,

segments.transliteration: Bismillaahir rahâmaanir rahâeem. âTadhroohur riyaahâu wa kaanallaahu aâlaa kulli shai-im muqtadiraa.â
segments.translation: Who were told by the people, âIndeed, the people have gathered against you, so fear them,â

segments.transliteration: Rabbanakshif aânnal aâdhaaba innaa mu-minoon.
segments.translation: So it increased them in faith, and they said: "Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the Best Disposer of Affairs."

segments.arabic: لا اِلهَ اِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْحَليمُ الْكَريمُ
segments.transliteration: Yauma-idhiyn yasâdurun naasu ashtaataa.
segments.translation: I seek refuge with Allah from the accursed devil,

segments.transliteration: Anfiru khifaafanw wa thiqaalaa.
segments.translation: And I entrust my affair to Allah,

segments.transliteration: Allaahumma antal hâaazâiru bimaknoonaatis saraa-iri, wazâ zâamaa-ir. Allaahumma aâzzazâ zâaalimu, wa qallan naasâiru, wa antal mutâtâaliuâl aâaâlim. Anna fulaanan zâalamanee wa aadhaanee, wa laa yash-hadu bidhaalika ghairak. Allaahumma innaka maalikuh. Allaahumma sarbaluhu sirbaalul hawaani, wa qammasâahu biqameesâir radaa.
segments.translation: Indeed, Allah is All-Seer of His servants,

segments.transliteration: Fa-akhadha humullaahu bidhunoobihim wa maa kaana lahum minallaahi minw waaq.
segments.translation: I seek refuge with Allah from the accursed devil,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اِنّى اَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ عِبادِكَ
segments.transliteration: Yaa shadeedal mihâaali, yaa aâzeezu adhlillata bi-iâzzatika jameeaâ min khalaqta fasâalli aâlaa muhâammadinw wa aalihi wakfinee mau-nata fulaanim bimaa shi-t.
segments.translation: Whatever mercy Allah opens for the people,

segments.arabic: نَجَاةٌ مِّنْكَ يَا سَيِّدِىْ الْكَرِيْمِ، نَجِّنَا وَ خَلِّصْنَا بِحَقِّ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ.
segments.transliteration: Yaa dhal quwwatil qaweeyati, yaa dhal iâzzatillatee kullu khalqika lahaa dhaleel. ikfinee haadhatâ tâaaghiyati wan taqim lee minhu.
segments.translation: No one can withhold it,

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَ بِاللهِ وَ مِنَ اللهِ وَ إِلَی اللهِ وَ فِىْ سَبِيْلِ اللهِ
segments.transliteration: Najaatum minka yaa sayyidil kareem. Najjinaa wa khallisânaa bihâaqqi bismillaahir rahâmaanir rahâeem.
segments.translation: And whatever He withholds, no one can send it forth after Him,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِلَيْك اَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِىْ، وَ إِلَيْكَ وجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىْ، وَ إلَيْكَ فَوَّضْتُ اَمرِىْ،
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma yaa faarijal hammi, wa munaffisal ghammee. Wa mudh-hibal ahâzaani wa mujeeba daâwatil muzâtâarreen. Yaa rahâmaanud dunyaa wal aakhirati wa rahâeemahumaa. Anta rahâmaanee wa rahâmaanu kulli shai-in farhâamnee rahâmatan tughneenee bihaa aânr rahâmati mIn siwaaka wa taqzâee bihaa dainee.
segments.translation: And He is the Mighty, the Wise.

segments.arabic: وَ احْفَظْنِيْ بِحِفْظِ اْلإِيْمَانِ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَىَّ وَ مِنْ خَلْفِىْ وَ عَنْ يَّمِيْنَِيْ وَ عَنْ شِمَالِىْ وَ مِنْ فَوْقِىْ وَ مِنْ تَحْتِیْ
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma aghninee bihâalaalika aân hâaraamika bifazâlika aâmman siwaaka yaa arhâamar raahâimeen.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful,

segments.arabic: وَ ادْفَعْ عَنِّيْ بِحَوْلِكَ وَ قُوَّتِكَ وَ لاَ حَوْلَ وَ لاَ قُوَّةَ اِلاَّ بِاللهِ الْعَلِىِّ الْعَظِيْمِ.
segments.transliteration: Yaa man huwa laisa binaa-imin fa-AUqizâuhu wa laa bighaafilin fa-adhakkirhu wa laa bighaa-ibin fa-antazâhiruHU yaa man huwa huw. Yaa Man yaâlamu maa huwa illaa huw. Yaa Man laa yaâlamu kaifa huwa illaa huw. Yaa khaaliqas samaawaati wal arzâi wa maa bainahumaa hâul bainee wa baina mAYn yU-dheenee wa yantaqima minnee. Innaka aâlaa kulli shai-in qadeer.
segments.translation: O Allah, protect us with Your eye that does not sleep,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اَذْهِبْ عَنِّيْ غَيْظَ قَلْبِىْ، و اغْفِرْ لِىْ ذَنْبِىْ، وَ اَجِرْنِيْ مِنْ مُضِلاَّتِ الْفِتَنِ، اَساَلُكَ رِضَاكَ، وَ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ اَسْاَلُكَ جَنَّتِكَ، وَ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ نَارِكَ، وَ اَسْاَلُكَ الْخَيْرَ كُلُّهُ، وَ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّرِّكُلُّهُ، اَللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْنِيْ عَلٰی الْهُدٰی وَ الصَّوَابِ، وَ اجْعَلْنِيْ رَاضِيًا مَرْضِيًّا غَيْرَ ضَالٍّ وَ لاَ مُضِلٍّ.
segments.transliteration: Alaisallaahu bikaafin aâbadu wa maa lanaa allaa natawakkalu aâlallaahi wa qad hadaanaa subulanaa wa lanasâbiranna aâlaa maa aadhaitumoonaa wa aâlallaahi fal yatawakkalil mutawakkiloon. Allaahumma innee anakhtu bibaabika wa awaitu ilaa fanaa-ik. Faf-aâl lee maa huwa oolaa bika birahâmatika yaa arhâamar raahâimeen.
segments.translation: And shelter us with Your support that cannot be surpassed,

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْم.ِ تَذْرُوْ هُ الرِّيٰحُ، وَ كَانَ اللهُ عَلٰی كُلِّ شَیْءٍ مُّقْتَدِرًا.
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma innee maghloobun fantasâirâ¦
segments.translation: And honor us with Your authority that cannot be violated,

segments.arabic: رَبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ اِنَّا مُوْمِنُوْنَ
segments.transliteration: ayawaddu ahâadukum antakoona lahu jannatum minan nakheelinw wa aaânaabin tajreemin tahâtihal anhaaru lahu feehaa min kullith thamaraati wa asâaabahul kibaru wa lahu dhurreeyatun zâuaâfaaa-A fa-asâaabahaa iiâsâaarun feehi naarun fahâtaraqatâ¦
segments.translation: And have mercy on us with Your power over us,

segments.transliteration: allaahumma tâammIhu bil balaa-i tâammanW wa aâmmahu bil balaa-i aâmmaN. IrMihi bihâijaaratiM min sijjeelinw wa tâairin abaabeel. Yaa aâleeyU yaa aâzâeem.
segments.translation: And do not destroy us while You are our hope.

segments.transliteration: AllaahummA inna fulaanabna fulaanIN zâalamanee wa laisa lee ahâadun usâoolu bihi ghairuka fastawaffa lee zâulaamatee as saaaâta as-saaaâta, bil ismilladhee sa-alaka bihil muzâtâarru fakashafta maa bihi min zâurrinw wa makkanta lahu fil arzâi wa ja-aâltahu khaleefataka aâlaa khalqika fas-aluka an tusâallee aâlaa muhâammadinw wa aali muhâammadinw wa an tastau fee lee zâulaamatis saaaâtas saaaâh.
segments.translation: My Lord, how many blessings have You bestowed upon me

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اَنْتَ الْحَاضِرُ بِمَكْنُوْنَاتِ السَّرَائِرِ، وَ الضَّمَائِرِ. اَللَّهُمَّ عَزَّ الظَّالِمُ، وَ قَلَّ النَّاصِرُ، وَ اَنْتَ الْمُطَّلِعُ الْعَالِمُ، اَنَّ فُلاَنًا ظَلَمَنِيْ وَ آذَانِيْ، وَ لاَ يَشْهَدُ بِذٰلِكَ غَيْرَكَ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ مَالِكُهُ، اَللَّهُمَّ سَرْبَلُهُ سِرْبَالُ الْهَوَانِ، وَ قَمَّصَهُ بِقَمِيْصِ الرَّدٰی.
segments.transliteration: Yaa man ahlaka aâaâdal AUlaa, wa thamooda famaa abqaa, wa qauma noohâim min qabli innahum kaanu hum azâlamu wa atâghaa wal mu-tafikatu ahwaa faghAshaahaa maa ghAshshaa inkaana fulaanabna fulaaniN zâaaliman feemaa artakabAnee bih. Faj-aâl aâlaihi minka waâdanw wa laa taj-aâla lahu fee hâilmika nasâeebaYn yaa aqrabal aqrabeen.
segments.translation: There has been little gratitude from me for them,

segments.arabic: فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللهُ بِذُنُوْبِهِمْ وَ مَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِنَ اللهِ مِنْ وَّاقٍ.
segments.transliteration: Yaa quwwata kulli zâaeâeâfin yaa mudhilla kulli jabbaarin qad wahâaqqika balaghal khaufu majhoodee fafarrij aânneeâ¦
segments.translation: And how many trials have You tested me with,

segments.arabic: يَا شَدِيْدَ الْمِحَالِ، يَا عَزِيْزُ اَذللّتَ بِعِزَّتِكَ جَمِيْعَ مِنْ خَلَقْتَ، فَصَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهِ وَ اكْفِنِيْ مَؤْنَةَ فُلاَنٍ بِمَا شِئْتَ.
segments.transliteration: yaa mudhalla kulli jabbaarin yaa muiâzza kulli dhaleelin, qad wa hâaqqIka aaâyaa sâabrEE fafarrij aânnee.
segments.translation: And there has been little patience from me during those times.

segments.arabic: يَا ذَا الْقُوَّةِ الْقَوِيَّةِ، وَ يَا ذَا الْعِزَّةِ الَّتِىْ كُلُّ خَلْقِكَ لَهَا ذَلِيْلٌ، اِكْفِنِيْ هٰذَا الطَّاغِيَةِ وَانْتَقِمْ لِىْ مِنْهُ.
segments.transliteration: Ash-hadu anna kulla maâboodim min tahâti aârshikA ilaa qaraari arzâika baatâilun illaa waj-haka taâlamu kurbatee fafarrij aânneeâ¦
segments.translation: O You who have received little gratitude for Your blessings,

segments.arabic: نَجَاةٌ مِنْكَ يَا سَيِّدِى الْكَرِيْمِ، نَجِّنَا وَ خَلِّصْنَا بِحَقِّ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma antal hâayyul qayyoomul aâleeyul aâzâeemul khaaliqul baari-ul muhâyil mumeetul badeeuâ lakal hâamdu wa lakal mannu wa lakal jood. Wahâdaka shareeka laka yaa waahâidu yaa ahâadu yaa sâamadu yaa man lam yalid wa lam yulad wa lam yakun lahu kufwan ahâad. Kadhaalikallaahu rabbEEâ¦
segments.translation: Yet You have not deprived me,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ يَا فَارِجَ الْهَمِّ وَ مُنَفِّسَ الْغَمِّ وَ مُذْهِبَ اْلاَحْزَانِ وَ مُجِيْبَ دَعْوَةِ الْمُضْطَرِّيْنَ يَا رَحْمٰنُ الدُّنْيَا وَ اْلآخِرَةِ وَ رَحِيْمَهُمَا اَنْتَ رَحْمَانِيْ وَ رَحْمٰنُ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ فَارْحَمْنِیْ رَحْمَةً تُغْنِيْنِیْ بِهَا عَنْ رَحْمَةِ مِنْ سِوَاكَ وَ تَقْضِیْ بِهَا دَيْنِيْ.
segments.transliteration: Sâalli (allaahumma) aâlaa muhâammadinw wa aali muhâammadisâ sâaadiqeen.
segments.translation: And O You who have received little patience during my trials,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اَغْنِنِيْ بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَ بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma laka yauman tantaqimu feehi LIl mazâloomi minazâ zâaalimi lakinna hala-eâeâ wajazaeâeâ laa yabghiyaani biYAsâsâabra aâlaa anaatika wa qad aâlImta anna fulaanan zâalamanee waâtadaa aâlayya biquwwatihi aâlaa zâaâfee fa as-aluka yaa rabbil iâzzati (wa qaasimIl arzaaqi) wa qaasâimal jabaabirati wa naasâiral mazâloomeen. An tureehi qudratika aqsamtu aâlaika yaa rabbil iâzzatis saaaâtas saaaâh.
segments.translation: Yet You have not forsaken me.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ هُوَ لَيْسَ بِنَائِمٍ فَاَوْقِظُهُ، وَ لاَ بِغَافِلٍ فَاَذْكِرُهُ، وَ لاَ بِغَائِبٍ فَاَنْتَظِرُهُ، يَا مَنْ هُوَ هُوَ، يَا مَنْ لاَ يَعْلَمُ مَا هُوَ إِلاَّ هُوَ، يَا مَنْ لاَ يَعْلَمُ كَيْفَ هُوَ اِلاَّ هُوَ، يَا خَالِقَ السَّمٰوَاتِ وَ اْلاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا، حُلْ بَيْنِيْ وَ بَيْنَ مَنْ يُؤْذِيْنِيْ وَ يَنْتَقِمَ مِنِّيْ، إِنَّكَ عَلٰی كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ.
segments.transliteration: aâoodhu billaahi minash shaitaanir rajeem
segments.translation: O You who sees me committing sins yet has not exposed me,

segments.arabic: اَلَيْسَ اللهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُ، وَ مَا لَنَا اَنْ لاَ نَتَوَكَلُّ عَلَی اللهِ وَ قَدْ هَدَانَا سُبُلَنَا، وَلَنَصْبِرَنَّ عَلٰی مَا آذَيْتُمُوْنَا وَ عَلَی اللهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُتَوَكِّلُوْنَ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ اَنَخْتُ بِبَابِكَ وَ اَوَيْتُ إِلٰى فِنَائِكَ، فَافْعَلْ لِىْ مَا هُوَ اَوْلٰى بِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ.
segments.translation: O You who is eternally known for Your kindness and never-ending generosity,
And O You who bestows blessings that cannot be counted,

segments.arabic: أَيَوَدُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ تَكُوْنَ لَهُ جَنَّةٌ مِّنْ نَّخِيْلٍ وَ أَعْنَابٍ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا اْلأَنْهَارُ لَهُ فِيْهَا مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ وَ أَصَابَهُ الْكِبَرُ وَ لَهُ ذُرِّيَّةٌ ضُعَفَآءَ فَأَصَابَهَا إِعْصَارٌ فِيْهِ نَارٌ فَاحْتَرَقَتْ.
segments.translation: I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the pure and righteous family of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ طَمِّهُ بِالبَلاَءِ طَمًّا، وَ عَمِّهُ بِالْبَلاَءِ عَمًّا، اِرْمِهِ بِحِجَارَةٍ مِنْ سِجِّيْلٍ، وَ طَيْرٍ اَبَابِيلٍ، يَا عَلِىُّ يَا عَظِيْمُ.
segments.translation: And I seek refuge with You from the adversaries and the tyrants.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلاَنَ ابْنَ فُلاَنٍ ظَلَمَنِيْ وَ لَيْسَ لِىْ اَحَدٌ اُصُوْلُ بِهِ غَيْرُكَ، فَاسْتَوَفَّ لِىْ ظُلاَمَتِىْ، السَّاعَةَ، السَّاعَةَ، بِاْلاِسْمِ الَّذِىْ سَاَلَكَ بِهِ الْمُضْطَرُّ فَكَشَفْتَ مَا بِهِ مِنْ ضُرٍّ، وَ مَكَّنْتَ لَهُ فِىْ اْلاَرْضِ وَ جَعَلْتَهُ خَلِيْفَتَكَ عَلٰی خَلْقِكَ، فَاَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّىَ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَ اَنْ تَسْتَوْفِىَ لِىْ ظُلامَتِىْ السَّاعَةَ السَّاعَةَ.
segments.translation: O Allah, help me in my religion in this world,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ اَهْلَكَ عَادًا اْلاَوْلٰی، وَ ثَمُوْدَ فَمَا اَبْقٰی، وَ قَوْمَ نُوْحٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ، إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا هُمْ اَظْلَمُ و اَطْغٰی، وَ الْمُؤْتَفِكَةُ اَهُوٰی، فَغَشَّاهَا مَا غَشّٰی، إِنْ كَانَ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ ظَالِمًا فِيْمَا ارْتَكَبَنِيْ بِهِ، فَاجْعَلْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْكَ وَعْدًا، وَ لاَ تَجْعَلَ لَهُ فِىْ حِلْمِكَ نَصِيْبًا يَا اَقْرَبَ اْلاَقْرَبِيْنَ.
segments.translation: And help me in my Hereafter with piety,

segments.arabic: يَا قُوَّةَ كُلِّ ضَعِيْفٍ يَا مُذِلَّ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ، قَدْ وَ حَقِّكَ بَلَغَ الْخَوْفُ مَجْهُوَدِىْ فَفَرِّجْ عَنِّيْ
segments.translation: And protect me in what I am absent from,

segments.arabic: يَا مُذَلَّ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ يَا مُعِزَّ كُلِّ ذَلِيْلٍ، قَدْ وَحَقِّكَ اَعْيَا صَبْرِىْ فَفَرِّجْ عَنِّيْ.
segments.translation: And do not leave me to rely on myself in what I attend.

segments.arabic: اَشْهَدُ اَنَّ كُلَّ مَعْبُوْدٍ مِنْ تَحْتِ عَرْشِكَ إِلٰی قَرَارِ اَرضِكَ بَاطِلٌ اِلاَّ وَجْهَكَ، تَعْلَمُ كُرْبَتِىْ فَفَرِّجْ عَنِّیْ
segments.translation: O You to whom forgiveness does not decrease, and disobedience does not harm,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اَنْتَ الْحَىُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ الْعَلِىُّ الْعَظِيْمُ، الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ، الْمُحْيِىْ الْمُمِيْتُ، الْبَدِيْعُ لَكَ الْكَرَمُ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَ لَكَ الْمَنُّ وَ لَكَ الْجُوْدُ، وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيْكَ لَكَ، يَا وَاحِدُ يَا اَحَدُ يَا صَمَدُ يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا اَحَدٌ كَذَالِكَ اللهُ رَبِّىْ،
segments.translation: I ask You for an immediate relief,

segments.arabic: صَلِّ (اَللَّهُمَّ) عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ الصَّادِقِيْنَ
segments.translation: And extensive patience,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ يَوْمًا تَنْتَقِمُ فِيْهِ لِلْمَظْلُوْمِ مِنَ الظَّالِمِ لٰكِنَّ هَلَعِىْ وَ جَزَعِىْ لاَ يَبْغِيَانِ بِىَ الصَّبَرَ عَلٰى اَنَاتِكَ وَ قَدْ عَلِمْتَ اَنَّ فُلاَنًا ظَلَمَنِيْ وَ اعْتَدٰی عَلَىَّ بِقُوَّتِهِ عَلٰی ضَعْفِىْ فَاَسْاَلُكَ يَا رَبِّ الْعَزَّةِ (وَ قَاسِمِ اْلاَرْزَاقِ) وَ قَاصِمَ الْجَبَابِرَةِ وَ نَاصِرَ الْمَظْلُوْمِيْنَ اَنْ تُرِيْهِ قُدْرَتِكَ اَقْسَمْتُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ السَّاعَةِ السَّاعَةِ.
segments.translation: And wellness from all afflictions,
And gratitude for the wellness,

segments.arabic: بِسۡمِ اللہِ مَا شَا ءَاللہُ ۔ لَا یَصۡرِ فُ السُّوۡ ءَ اِلآَ اللہُ بِسۡمِ اللہِ مِا شَاءَ اللہُ لَا یَسُوۡقُ الۡخَیۡرَ اِلَّا اللہُ بِسۡمِ اللہِ مَا شاءَاللہُ، مَا یَکُوۡنُ مِنۡ نِعۡمۃٍ فَمِنَ اللہِ، بِسۡمِ اللہِ مَا شاءَاللہُ ۔ لا حوۡ لَ وَلَا قُوَّۃَ اِلآَ بِا للہِ الۡعَلیِّ الۡعَظِیۡمِ بِسۡمِ اللہِ مَا شاءَ اللہُ وَ صَلّی اللہُ عٰلٰی مُحمَّدٍ وَ آلِہِ الطَّیِّبِیۡنَ۔
segments.translation: O Most Merciful of the merciful.
There is no god but Allah, the Forbearing, the Generous.
Glory be to Allah, the Lord of the seven heavens.
And the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
And all praise is due to Allah, the Lord of all worlds.
O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of Your servants.
Success is from You O my kind Chief. Give us success and make us sincere by the right of âin the name of Allah, the Beneficent the Mercifulâ.
In the name of Allah and by Allah and from Allah and for the sake of Allah.
O Allah I submit my self to Thee, and towards You I have turned my face, and towards You I have entrusted my affair.
And protect me by the safety of faith from before me and from behind me, and from my right and from my left and from above me and from below me.
And ward off from me by Your power and Your strength; and there is no power and might except by Allah, the Exalted and the Mighty.[1]

O Allah take away from me the anger of my heart, and forgive me my sins, and take me away from mischief and deviations. I ask You Your pleasure, and I seek refuge of Your displeasure. I ask You Your Paradise and seek refuge by You from Your Fire (Hell). And I ask You for all the good and seek refuge from all evils. O Allah, make me firm on guidance and the correct way, and make me satisfied and able to satisfy You, and not a deviant and deviator.[1] Hilyat al-Muttaqeen, Ash-Shaykh al-Majlisi, Pg. 448
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent the Merciful. Which the winds scatter; and Allah is the holder of power over all things.[2]Surah Kahf 18:45
Our Lord! Remove from us the punishment; surely we are believers.[3] Surah Dukhan 44:12
On that day men shall come forth in sundry bodies[4]Surah Zilzal 99:6
Go forth light and heavy.[5]Surah Tawbah 9:41

O Allah, You are cognizant of all the hidden things of the secrets and intentions. O Allah, the oppressors are more and the helpers are less. And You are the informed One, the Knowing, that so and so has oppressed me and hurt me and except for You, none is a witness upon that. O Allah indeed You are the owner. O Allah, degrade him absolutely and strip him off his oppressions.
But Allah destroyed them for their sins; and there was not for them any defender against Allah.[6]Surah Momin 40:21

O One most difficult to comprehend, O Powerful One, by Your power You suppress all those You have created. Then bless Muhammad and his progeny and save me from the evil of so and so by whatever You wish.
O One with a strong might, and O one with might with which everything that You created is debased. Save me from this tyrant and take my revenge from him.[8] Nuzhat al-Jalees, Vol. 2, Pg. 472
Salvation is from You, O Kind Chief, save us and release us by the right of: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

O Allah, O remover of sorrow, and the dispeller of sadness, and the curer of griefs and the answerer of prayers of the troubled ones, O Beneficent one of the world and the hereafter and the forgiver of the two. You are Beneficent for me and Beneficent for everything. Then give me such a mercy that I become needless of all mercy from others than You. And through it liquidate my debts.
O Allah, make me self-sufficient by Your permissible from Your prohibited and through Your grace from those other than You. O the best of the merciful ones.

O One Who is not asleep that he should be awakened, and One Who is never forgetful that he should be reminded, One Who is not absent that he should be waited for. O One Who is what He is. O One Who does not know what He is but that He is. O one Who does not know how He is but that He is. O Creator of the heavens and the earth and what is between them. Become a barrier between me and the one who is causing harm to me or wants to take revenge from me. Indeed You are powerful over everything.

Is not Allah sufficient for His servant? And are we not supposed to rely on Allah while He has guided us on our paths, and indeed we would be patient when subjected to hardships. And upon Allah should rely the reliant ones. O Allah, I have halted at Your door and approached Your court. Then do for me what is the best of You by Your mercy, O the best of the merciful ones.
O Allah I have been overpowered, then help me,

O Allah, push him in the earth and bury him, make him blind by the calamities so that he becomes blind, throw at him from pebbles of baked clay and send down (to prey) upon them birds in flocks. O the High and the Great!

O Allah, so and so son of so and so has oppressed me and there is no resort for me except You. Then remove his oppression from me. Right now, right now, right now. By the name the distressed one asks You and You remove harm from him. And You settle him in the earth and appoints Him as Your Caliph on Your creatures. Then I am also asking You to bless Muhammad and the progeny of Muhammad that You remove for me my oppression, this moment, this moment.

O One Who destroyed the Ad first and then the Thamud and they did not survive, and the people of Nuh previously. They were of those most unjust and rebellious. They followed the passions. Then they were covered with what covers. That so and so son of so and so is unjust in what he has done to me. Then appoint on him Your promise and do not appoint for him Your forbearance, O the most proximate of the proximate ones.
O strength of all the weak ones. O One who debases all the oppressors. Indeed by Your right, the fear has affected my endeavor. So remove it from me.
O One Who debases all the tyrants and honors all the dishonored ones, indeed by Your right, my patience has reached its limit. So remove it from me.
I testify that all the deities that are on the earth below Your sky are all false except Your face. You are aware of my grief. Then remove it from me.

O Allah You are the Living, the Eternal, the High and the Great. The Creator of the living things. The giver of life and death. The Originator, for You is the kindness and for You is the praise and for you is the favor, and for You is the generosity. Your Oneness, there is no partner for You. O the One, O the Unique, O the Self-sufficient. O One Who does not beget and is not begotten. And there is none like Him. Such is Allah, my Lord.
Invoke blessings (O Allah) on Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad, the truthful ones.

O Allah, for You is the day when You will take revenge from the oppressors for the oppressed one. But my sorrow and distress overpower my patience due to delay from Your side while You indeed know that so and so has oppressed me and had been unjust to me by his power upon my weakness. Then I ask You, O Lord of Majesty (and the distributor of sustenance) and the slayer of the tyrants and the helper of the oppressed ones, that You show him Your power. I swear by You, O Lord of the Might, right now, just now.

By the blessing of these words, Almighty Allah will protect you from their evil. No doubt, these hypocrites are like devils, who talk flatteringly to deceive. But if you want to be protected from drowning, fire and loss of property, recite this supplication every morning:

In the name of Allah, as Allah willed â None removes  the troubles except Allah. In the Name of  Allah, as Allah willed. None  sends any good except Allah. In the Name of Allah, as Allah willed, there is no power and strength except with Allah, the High and Mighty. In the Name of Allah, as Allah willed, and may Allah bless Muhammad and his pure progeny.

segments.transliteration: fa-inna sh-sharÄ«fa man sharrafaá¹¯hu á¹­Äâatuka
segments.translation: For the noble one is he whom Your obedience ennobles.

segments.transliteration: wal-âazÄ«za man aâazzat-hu âibÄdatuka
segments.translation: And the mighty is he whom Your worship strengthens.

segments.transliteration: fa-á¹£alli âalÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa-Älihi
segments.translation: So bless Muhammad and his family.

segments.transliteration: wa-mattiânÄ bitharwatin lÄ tanfadu
segments.translation: And grant us an endless wealth.

segments.transliteration: wa-ayyidnÄ bi-âizzin lÄ yufqadu
segments.translation: And support us with a strength that never vanishes.

segments.transliteration: wa-asriá¸¥nÄ fÄ« mulki l-abad
segments.translation: And let us roam freely in the kingdom of eternity.

segments.transliteration: innaka l-wÄá¸¥idu l-aá¸¥adu á¹£-á¹£amadu
segments.translation: Indeed, You are the One, the Only, the Eternal Refuge.

segments.transliteration: alladhÄ« lam talid wa-lam tÅ«lad
segments.translation: The One who neither begets nor is begotten.

segments.transliteration: wa-lam yakun laka kufuwan aá¸¥ad
segments.translation: And none is comparable to You.

segments.transliteration: aal-h'am-du ll-lahee riz''an bih'uk-mil-laah shahit-tu an-nal-laah
segments.translation: 1.Praise belongs to God in satisfaction with God's decision!

segments.arabic: شَهِدْتُ أَنَّ اللهَ قَسَمَ مَعَايِشَ عِبَادِهِ بِالْعَدْلِ ،
segments.transliteration: qas-sama maa'ayisha i'baadihee bil-a'd-l
segments.translation: 2.I bear witness that God has apportioned the livelihoods of His servants with justice

segments.transliteration: wa akhad'a a'laa jameei' khal-qihee bil-faz''-l
segments.translation: 3.and undertaken bounty for all His creatures.

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih
segments.translation: 4.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: wa laa taf-tin-nee bimaaa aa'-t'ay-tahum
segments.translation: 5.tempt me not with what You hast given to Your creatures

segments.arabic: وَلا تَفْتِنْهُمْ بِمَا مَنَعْتَنِي فَأحْسُدَ خَلْقَكَ، وَأَغْمِطَ حُكْمَكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa taf-tin-hum bimaa manaa'-tanee faah'-suda khal-qak wa agh-mit'a h'uk-mak
segments.translation: 6.and tempt them not with what You hast withheld from me, lest I envy Your creatures and despise Your decision!

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih
segments.translation: 7.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: wa t'ay-yib biqaz''aaa-ika naf-see
segments.translation: 8.delight my soul through Your decree,

segments.transliteration: wa was-sia' bimawaaqii' h'uk-mika s'ad-ree
segments.translation: 9.expand my breast through the instances of Your decision,

segments.transliteration: wa hab leeath-thiqata liuqir-ra maa'haa
segments.translation: 10.give to me a trust through which I may admit

segments.arabic: بِأََنَّ قَضَاءَكَ لَمْ يَجْرِ إلاَّ بِالْخِيَرَةِ
segments.transliteration: bi an-na qaz''aaa-aka lam yaj-ri il-laa bil-kheearah
segments.translation: 11.that Your decree runs only to the best,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ شُكْرِي لَكَ عَلَى مَا زَوَيْتَ عَنّي
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l shuk-ree laka a'laa maa zaway-ta a'n-neee
segments.translation: 12.and let my gratitude to You for what You hast taken away from me

segments.arabic: أَوْفَرَ مِنْ شُكْرِي إيَّاكَ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنِي
segments.transliteration: aw-fara min shuk-reee ee-yaaka a'laa maa khaw-wal-tanee
segments.translation: 13.be more abundant than my gratitude to You for what You hast conferred upon me!

segments.arabic: وَاعْصِمْنِي مِن أنْ أظُنَّ بِذِي عَدْم خَسَاسَةً،
segments.transliteration: waa'-s'im-nee min an az'un-na bid'ee a'damin khasaasah
segments.translation: 14.Preserve me from imagining any meanness in someone who is destitute

segments.transliteration: aw az'un-na bis'aah'ibi thar-watin faz''-laa
segments.translation: 15.or imagining any superiority in someone who possesses wealth,

segments.transliteration: fa in-nash-shareefa man shar-rafat-hoo t'aaa'tuk
segments.translation: 16.for the noble is he whom obedience to You has ennobled

segments.transliteration: wal-a'zeeza man aa'z-zat-hoo i'baadatuk
segments.translation: 17.and the exalted is he whom worship of You has exalted!

segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih
segments.translation: 18.So bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَمَتِّعْنَا بِثَرْوَة لاَ تَنْفَدُ، وَأَيِّدْنَا بِعِزٍّ لاَ يُفْقَدُ
segments.transliteration: wa mat-tia'-naa bithar-watil-laa tanfad wa ay-yid-naa bii'z-zil-laa yuf-qad
segments.translation: 19.give us to enjoy a wealth which does not run out, confirm us with an exaltation which will never be lost,

segments.transliteration: wa as-rih'-naa fee mul-kil-abad
segments.translation: 20.and let us roam freely in the kingdom of everlastingness!

segments.transliteration: in-nakal-waah'idul-sh'adus'-s'amad
segments.translation: 21.Surely You art the One, 'the Unique, the Eternal Refuge;

segments.transliteration: al-lad'ee lam talid walam toolad
segments.translation: 22.You hast not begotten, nor hast You been begotten,

segments.transliteration: wa lam yakul-laka kufuwan ah'ad
segments.translation: 23.and equal to You is not any one' (ref.112:1-4)!

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ بِقُوَّتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: al-á¸¥amdu lillÄhi alladhÄ« khalaqa al-layla wa-n-nahÄra bi-quwwatihi,
segments.translation: All praise belongs to Allah, who created the night and the day by His power,

segments.transliteration: wa-mayyaza baynahumÄ bi-qudratihi,
segments.translation: and distinguished between them by His might,

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلَ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا حَدّاً مَحْدُوداً، وَأَمَداً مَمْدُوداً،
segments.transliteration: wa-jaÊ¿ala li-kulli wÄá¸¥idin minhumÄ á¸¥addan maá¸¥dÅ«dan, wa-amadan mamdÅ«dan,

segments.arabic: يُولِجُ كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا فِي صَاحِبِهِ،
segments.transliteration: yÅ«liju kulla wÄá¸¥idin minhumÄ fÄ« á¹£Äá¸¥ibihi,
segments.translation: He makes one of them enter into the other,

segments.arabic: وَيُولِجُ صَاحِبَهُ فِيهِ بِتَقْدِيرٍ مِنْهُ لِلْعِبَادِ،
segments.transliteration: wa-yÅ«liju á¹£Äá¸¥ibahu fÄ«hi bi-taqdÄ«rin minhu li-l-Ê¿ibÄd,

segments.transliteration: fÄ«mÄ yaghdhÅ«hum bihi wa-yunshiÊ¾uhum Ê¿alayhi,
segments.translation: in what He nourishes them with and raises them upon.

segments.arabic: فَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا فِيهِ مِنْ حَرَكَاتِ التَّعَبِ،
segments.transliteration: fa-khalaqa lahumu al-layla li-yaskunÅ« fÄ«hi min á¸¥arakÄti l-taÊ¿ab,

segments.arabic: وَنَهَضَاتِ النَّصَبِ، وَجَعَلَهُ لِبَاساً لِيَلْبَسُوا مِنْ رَاحَتِهِ وَمَنَامِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa-nahaá¸Äti l-naá¹£ab, wa-jaÊ¿alahu libÄsan li-yalbasÅ« min rÄá¸¥atihi wa-manÄmihi,
segments.translation: and from the risings of exhaustion; and He made it a covering, so they may wear its comfort and its sleep,

segments.arabic: فَيَكُونَ ذَلِكَ لَھُم جَمَاماً وَقُوَّةً، وَلِيَنَالُوا بِهِ لَذَّةً وَشَهْوَةً.
segments.transliteration: fa-yakÅ«na dhÄlika  lahum jamÄman wa-quwwatan, wa-li-yanÄlÅ« bihi ladhdhatan wa-shahwatan.
segments.translation: so that it becomes for them rest and strength, and so they may gain through it pleasure and desire.

segments.arabic: وَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ النَّهَارَ مُبْصِراً لِيَبْتَغُوا فِيهِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa-khalaqa lahumu l-nahÄra mubá¹£iran li-yabtaghÅ« fÄ«hi min faá¸lihi,
