segments.arabic: وَلِيَتَسَبَّبُوا إِلَى رِزْقِهِ، وَيَسْرَحُوا فِي أَرْضِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa-li-yatasabbabÅ« ilÄ rizqihi, wa-yasraá¸¥Å« fÄ« ará¸ihi,
segments.translation: and that they may strive for His sustenance and roam in His earth,

segments.arabic: طَلَباً لِمَا فِيهِ نَيْلُ الْعَاجِلِ مِنْ دُنْيَاهُمْ،
segments.transliteration: á¹­alaban li-mÄ fÄ«hi naylu l-Ê¿Äjili min dunyÄhum,
segments.translation: seeking thereby what can be attained quickly from their worldly life,

segments.arabic: وَدَرَكُ الْآجِلِ فِي أُخْرَاهُمْ. بِكُلِّ ذَلِكَ يُصْلِحُ شَأْنَهُمْ،
segments.transliteration: wa-daraku l-Äjili fÄ« ukhrÄhum. bi-kulli dhÄlika yuá¹£liá¸¥u shaÊ¾nahum,
segments.translation: and the attainment of the Hereafter in their next life. Through all this, He sets their affairs aright,

segments.arabic: وَيَبْلُو أَخْبَارَهُمْ وَيَنْظُرُ كَيْفَ هُمْ فِي أَوْقَاتِ طَاعَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa-yablÅ« akhbÄrahum wa-yanáºuru kayfa hum fÄ« awqÄti á¹­ÄÊ¿atihi,
segments.translation: and tests their deeds, and observes how they are in the times of His obedience,

segments.transliteration: wa-manÄzili furÅ«á¸ihi wa-mawÄqiÊ¿i aá¸¥kÄmihi,
segments.translation: and the stations of His obligations, and the places of His rulings,

segments.arabic: لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسَاءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى.
segments.transliteration: li-yajziya alladhÄ«na asÄÊ¾Å« bi-mÄ Ê¿amilÅ« wa-yajziya alladhÄ«na aá¸¥sanÅ« bi-l-á¸¥usnÄ,
segments.translation: so that He may recompense those who did evil with what they did, and reward those who did good with the best reward.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا فَلَقْتَ لَنَا مِنَ الْإِصْبَاحِ،
segments.transliteration: allÄhumma fa-laka l-á¸¥amdu Ê¿alÄ mÄ falaqta lanÄ mina l-iá¹£bÄá¸¥,
segments.translation: O Allah! To You belongs all praise for what You split for us of the morning light,

segments.transliteration: wa-mattaÊ¿tanÄ bihi min á¸awÊ¾i l-nahÄr,
segments.translation: and for giving us enjoyment in it of the brightness of the day,

segments.transliteration: wa-baá¹£á¹£artanÄ min maá¹­Älibi l-aqwÄt,
segments.translation: and for showing us the paths of seeking our sustenance,

segments.transliteration: wa-waqaytanÄ fÄ«hi min á¹­awÄriqi l-ÄfÄt,
segments.translation: and for protecting us in it from sudden calamities.

segments.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَتِ الْأَشْيَاءُ كُلُّهَا بِجُمْلَتِهَا لَكَ:
segments.transliteration: aá¹£baá¸¥nÄ wa-aá¹£baá¸¥ati l-ashyÄÊ¾u kulluhÄ bi-jumlatihÄ laka,
segments.translation: We have entered the morning, and all things altogether belong to You:

segments.arabic: سَمَاؤُهَا وَأَرْضُهَا وَمَا بَثَثْتَ فِي كُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا،
segments.transliteration: samÄÊ¾uhÄ wa-ará¸uhÄ wa-mÄ baththta fÄ« kulli wÄá¸¥idin minhumÄ,
segments.translation: its heavens and its earth, and whatever You have spread in each of them,

segments.transliteration: sÄkinuhu wa-mutaá¸¥arrikuhu wa-muqÄ«muhu wa-shÄkhiá¹£u,
segments.translation: its still and its moving, its settled and its departing,

segments.arabic: وَمَا عَلَا فِي الْهَوَاءِ وَمَا كَنَّ تَحْتَ الثَّرَى،
segments.transliteration: wa-mÄ Ê¿alÄ fÄ« l-hawÄÊ¾ wa-mÄ kanna taá¸¥ta l-tharÄ,
segments.translation: whatever rises in the air, and whatever lies hidden beneath the soil.

segments.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا فِي قَبْضَتِكَ، يَحْوِينَا مُلْكُكَ وَسُلْطَانُكَ،
segments.transliteration: aá¹£baá¸¥nÄ fÄ« qabá¸atika, yaá¸¥wÄ«nÄ mulkuka wa-sulá¹­Änuka,
segments.translation: We have entered the morning within Your grasp, encompassed by Your dominion and authority,

segments.arabic: وَتَضُمُّنَا مَشِيَّتُكَ، وَنَتَصَرَّفُ عَنْ أَمْرِكَ، وَنَتَقَلَّبُ فِي تَدْبِيرِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-taá¸ummunÄ mashÄ«yyatuka, wa-nataá¹£arrfu Ê¿an amrika, wa-nataqallabu fÄ« tadbÄ«rika,
segments.translation: and encompassed by Your will; we move only by Your command, and we change only by Your management,

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ لَنَا مِنَ الْأَمْرِ إِلَّا مَا قَضَيْتَ، وَلَا مِنَ الْخَيْرِ إِلَّا مَا أَعْطَيْتَ.
segments.transliteration: laysa lanÄ mina l-amri illÄ mÄ qaá¸ayta, wa-lÄ mina l-khayri illÄ mÄ aÊ¿á¹­ayta,
segments.translation: we have no affair except what You have decreed, and no good except what You have granted.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا يَوْمٌ حَادِثٌ جَدِيدٌ، وَهُوَ عَلَيْنَا شَاهِدٌ عَتِيدٌ،
segments.transliteration: wa-hÄdhÄ yawmun á¸¥Ädithun jadÄ«dun, wa-huwa Ê¿alaynÄ shÄhidun Ê¿atÄ«dun,
segments.translation: And this is a new day, and it is a present witness over us,

segments.arabic: إِنْ أَحْسَنَّا وَدَّعَنَا بِحَمْدٍ، وَإِنْ أَسَأْنَا فَارَقَنَا بِذَمٍّ.
segments.transliteration: in aá¸¥sannÄ wadaÊ¿anÄ bi-á¸¥amdin, wa-in asÄÊ¾nÄ fÄraqanÄ bi-dhamm,
segments.translation: if we do good, it leaves us with praise; and if we do evil, it leaves us with blame.

segments.transliteration: allÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa-Älihi,
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family,

segments.transliteration: Wa rzqunÄ á¸¥usna muá¹£Äá¸¥abatihi waÊ¿á¹£imnÄ,
segments.translation: Grant us good companionship with him and protect us,

segments.transliteration: Min sÅ«âi mufÄraqatihÄ« bi irtikÄbi jarÄ«rah,
segments.translation: From the harm of parting from him by committing a sin,

segments.transliteration: Aw iqtirÄfi á¹£aghÄ«rah aw kabÄ«rah,
segments.translation: Whether committing a small or large sin.

segments.arabic: وَأَجْزِلْ لَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ وَأَخْلِنَا فِيهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ.
segments.transliteration: Wa ajzil lanÄ fÄ«hi mina al-á¸¥asanÄti wa akhlinÄ fÄ«hi mina as-sayyiâÄt,
segments.translation: And generously grant us in it good deeds and spare us from evils.

segments.arabic: وَامْلَأْ لَنَا مَا بَيْنَ طَرَفَيْهِ حَمْدًا وَشُكْرًا وَأَجْرًا وَذُخْرًا وَفَضْلًا وَإِحْسَانًا.
segments.transliteration: Wa amlaâ lanÄ mÄ bayna á¹­arafayhi á¸¥amdan wa shukran wa ajran wa dhukhran wa faá¸lan wa iá¸¥sÄnan,
segments.translation: And fill for us between its two edges with praise, thanks, reward, treasure, bounty, and goodness.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَسِّرْ عَلَى الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ مَؤُونَتَنَا،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma yassir Ê¿alÄ al-kirÄmi al-kÄtibÄ«n maâÅ«natana,
segments.translation: O Allah, ease for the noble scribes our provision,

segments.transliteration: Wa amlaâ lanÄ min á¸¥asanÄtinÄ á¹£aá¸¥Äâifana,
segments.translation: And fill our pages with our good deeds.

segments.transliteration: Wa lÄ tukhzinÄ Ê¿indahum bisÅ«âi aÊ¿mÄlinÄ,
segments.translation: And do not disgrace us before them by our bad deeds.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لَنَا فِي كُلِّ سَاعَةٍ مِنْ سَاعَاتِهِ حَظًّا مِنْ عِبَادِكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma ijÊ¿al lanÄ fÄ« kulli sÄÊ¿atin min sÄÊ¿Ätihi á¸¥aáºáºan min Ê¿ibÄdika,
segments.translation: O Allah, make for us in every hour of its hours a share among Your servants,

segments.arabic: وَنَصِيبًا مِنْ شُكْرِكَ وَشَاهِدَ صِدْقٍ مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِكَ.
segments.transliteration: Wa naá¹£Ä«ban min shukrika wa shÄhida á¹£idqin min malÄÊ¾ikatika,
segments.translation: And a portion of Your thanks and a truthful witness from Your angels.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi,
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muá¸¥ammad and his family,

segments.arabic: وَاحْفَظْنَا مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِينَا وَمِنْ خَلْفِنَا وَعَنْ أَيْمَانِنَا وَعَنْ شَمَائِلِنَا،
segments.transliteration: Wa iá¸¥faáºnÄ min bayni aydÄ«nÄ wa min khalfina wa Ê¿an aymÄnina wa Ê¿an shamÄâilina,
segments.translation: And protect us from before us, behind us, from our right and our left,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ جَمِيعِ نَوَاحِينَا حِفْظًا عَاصِمًا مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa min jamÄ«Ê¿i nawÄá¸¥inÄ á¸¥ifáºan Ê¿Äá¹£iman min maÊ¿á¹£iyatika,
segments.translation: And from all our directions, a protective guard from Your disobedience,

segments.transliteration: HÄdiyÄn ilÄ á¹­ÄÊ¿atika mustaÊ¿milan li maá¸¥abbatika,
segments.translation: Guiding us to obey You and using us for Your love.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muá¸¥ammad and his family,

segments.arabic: وَوَفِّقْنَا فِي يَوْمِنَا هَذَا وَلَيْلَتِنَا هَذِهِ وَفِي جَمِيعِ أَيَّامِنَا
segments.transliteration: Wa waffiqnÄ fÄ« yawmnÄ hÄdhÄ wa laylatinÄ hÄdhihi wa fÄ« jamÄ«Ê¿i ayyÄminÄ,
segments.translation: And grant us success on this day of ours, this night, and all our days,

segments.arabic: لاِسْتِعْمَالِ الْخَيْرِ وَهِجْرَانِ الشَّرِّ وَشُكْرِ النِّعَمِ،
segments.transliteration: Li istiÊ¿mÄli al-khayr wa hijrÄni ash-sharr wa shukri an-niÊ¿am,
segments.translation: For practicing good, abandoning evil, and being grateful for blessings,

segments.transliteration: Wa itti'bÄÊ¿i as-sunan wa mujÄnabati al-bidaÊ¿,
segments.translation: Following the traditions and avoiding innovations,

segments.transliteration: Wa al-amri bil-maÊ¿rÅ«f wa an-nahy Ê¿an al-munkar,
segments.translation: Enjoining good and forbidding evil,

segments.transliteration: Wa á¸¥iyÄá¹­ati al-islÄm wa intiqÄá¹£i al-bÄá¹­il wa idhlÄlih,
segments.translation: Protecting Islam and reducing falsehood and humiliating it,

segments.transliteration: Wa nuá¹£rati al-á¸¥aqq wa iÊ¿zÄzihi, wa irshÄdi aá¸-á¸Äll,
segments.translation: Supporting the truth and elevating it, and guiding the lost,

segments.transliteration: Wa muÊ¿Äwanati aá¸-á¸aÊ¿Ä«f wa idrÄki l-lahÄ«f,
segments.translation: And helping the weak and reaching out to the troubled/distressed.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muá¸¥ammad and his family,

segments.transliteration: Wa jÊ¿alhu ayman yawmin Ê¿ahadnÄhu,
segments.translation: And make it the most auspicious day we have ever pledged,

segments.transliteration: Wa afá¸ala á¹£Äá¸¥ib á¹£iá¸¥ibnÄhu,
segments.translation: And the best companion we have accompanied,

segments.transliteration: Wa khayra waqtin áºalalnÄ fÄ«hi,
segments.translation: And the best time we have lived in.

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أَرْضَى مَنْ مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ مِنْ جُمْلَةِ خَلْقِكَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa jÊ¿alnÄ min ardÄ man marra Ê¿alayhi al-laylu wa an-nahÄru min jumlat khalqik,
segments.translation: And make us among those most pleasing to whom the night and day pass of Your creation,

segments.transliteration: Wa ashkarahum limÄ awlayta min niÊ¿amik,
segments.translation: And the most grateful for what You have given in blessings,

segments.transliteration: Wa aqwamahum bimÄ sharaÊ¿ta min sharÄÊ¾iÊ¿ik,
segments.translation: And the most upright in following Your laws,

segments.transliteration: Wa awqafahum Ê¿ammÄ á¸¥adhharta min nahyik,
segments.translation: And the one who restrains himself from what You have warned against forbidding.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَشْهَدُكَ وَكَفَى بِكَ شَهِيدًا وَأُشْهِدُ سَمَاءَكَ وَأَرْضَكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« ashhaduka wa kafÄ bika shahÄ«dan wa ush-hidu samÄÊ¾aka wa ará¸aka,
segments.translation: O Allah, I bear witness to You and enough is You as a witness, and I call upon Your sky and Your earth,

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ أَسْكَنْتَهُمَا مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِكَ وَسَائِرِ خَلْقِكَ فِي يَوْمِي هَذَا،
segments.transliteration: Wa man askantahumÄ min malÄÊ¾ikatika wa sÄÊ¾iri khalqika fÄ« yawmi hÄdhÄ,
segments.translation: And those You have made inhabit them of Your angels and all Your creation on this day of mine,

segments.arabic: وَسَاعَتِي هَذِهِ، وَلَيْلَتِي هَذِهِ، وَمُسْتَقَرِّي هَذَا،
segments.transliteration: Wa sÄÊ¿atÄ« hÄdhihi, wa laylatÄ« hÄdhihi, wa mustaqarrÄ« hÄdhÄ,
segments.translation: And this hour of mine, this night of mine, and this resting place of mine,

segments.arabic: أَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي
segments.transliteration: AnnÄ« ash-hadu annaka anta allÄhu alladhÄ«
segments.translation: That I bear witness that You are Allah who

segments.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ قَائِمٌ بِالْقِسْطِ،
segments.transliteration: LÄ ilÄha illÄ anta qÄâimun bil-qisá¹­,
segments.translation: There is no deity but You, established in justice,

segments.transliteration: Ê¿Adlun fÄ« al-á¸¥ukmi, raÊ¾Å«fun bil-Ê¿ibÄd,
segments.translation: Just in judgment, compassionate to the servants,

segments.transliteration: MÄliku al-mulki raá¸¥Ä«mun bil-khalq,
segments.translation: Master of the kingdom, merciful to creation,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ وَخِيَّرَتُكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa anna Muá¸¥ammadan Ê¿abduka wa rasÅ«luka wa khÄ«yaratuka min khalqik,
segments.translation: And that Muá¸¥ammad is Your servant and messenger and Your chosen among Your creation,

segments.arabic: حَمَّلْتَهُ رِسَالَتَكَ فَأَدَّاهَا وَأَمَرْتَهُ بِالنُّصْحِ لِأُمَّتِهِ فَنَصَحَ لَهَا.
segments.transliteration: Hammaltahu risÄlataka fa addÄhÄ wa amartahu bin-nuá¹£á¸¥ li ummatihi fa naá¹£aá¸¥a lahÄ,
segments.translation: You entrusted him with Your message, and he delivered it and commanded earnest advice for his nation, so he advised them well.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ أَكْثَرَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma faá¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi akthara mÄ á¹£allayta Ê¿alÄ aá¸¥adin min khalqik,
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muá¸¥ammad and his family more than You have sent blessings on anyone of Your creation,

segments.arabic: وَآتِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا آتَيْتَ أَحَدًا مِنْ عِبَادِكَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa Ätih Ê¿annÄ afá¸ala mÄ Ätayta aá¸¥adan min Ê¿ibÄdik,
segments.translation: And grant him on our behalf the best of what You have given any of Your servants,

segments.arabic: وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ وَأَكْرَمَ مَا جَزَيْتَ أَحَدًا مِنْ أَنْبِيَائِكَ عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ.
segments.transliteration: Wa ajzih Ê¿annÄ afá¸ala wa akrama mÄ jazayta aá¸¥adan min anbiyÄâika Ê¿an ummatih,
segments.translation: And reward him on our behalf the best and most generous of what You rewarded any of Your prophets for his nation.

segments.arabic: إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بِالْجَسِيمِ الْغَافِرِ لِلْعَظِيمِ،
segments.transliteration: Inna ka anta al-mannÄn bi al-jasÄ«m al-ghÄfir lil-Ê¿aáºÄ«m,
segments.translation: Indeed, You are the Benefactor, the Great, the Forgiver of the Great sins,

segments.transliteration: Wa anta ará¸¥amu min kulli raá¸¥Ä«m,
segments.translation: And You are more Merciful than all who show mercy,

segments.transliteration: Fa á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi
segments.translation: So send blessings on Muá¸¥ammad and his family,

segments.transliteration: Aá¹­-á¹­ayyibÄ«n aá¹­-á¹­ÄhirÄ«n al-akhyÄr al-anjabÄ«n.
segments.translation: The pure, the clean, the good, the most noble.

segments.arabic: أَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهارَ بِقُوَّتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: al-h'am-du lil-laahil-lad'ee khalaqal-lay-la wan-nahaara biqoo-watih
segments.translation: 1.Praise belongs to God, who created night and day through His strength,

segments.transliteration: wa may-yaza bay-nahumaa biqud-ratih
segments.translation: 2.set them apart through His power,

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلَ لِكُلِّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا حَدّاً مَحْدُوداً، وَأَمَداً مَمْدُوداً ،
segments.transliteration: wa jaa'la likul-li waah'idim-minhumaa h'ad-dam-mah'-doodaw-wa amadam-mam-doodaa
segments.translation: 3.and appointed for each a determined limit and a drawn-out period.

segments.arabic: يُولِجُ كُلَّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا فِي صَاحِبِهِ،
segments.transliteration: yooliju kul-la waah'idim-min-humaa fee s'aah'ibihee
segments.translation: 4.He makes each of the two enter into its companion,

segments.arabic: وَيُولِجُ صَاحِبَهُ فِيهِ بِتَقْدِير مِنْهُ لِلْعِبَادِ
segments.transliteration: wa yooliju s'aah'ibahoo feeh bitaq-deerim-min-hoo lil-i'baadi
segments.translation: 5.and makes its companion enter into it, as an ordainment from Him for His servants

segments.transliteration: feemaa yagh-d'oohum bihee wa yunshi-uhum a'lay-h
segments.translation: 6.in that through which He feeds them and with which He makes them grow.

segments.arabic: فَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ اللَّيْـلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا فِيْهِ مِنْ حَرَكَاتِ التَّعَبِ،
segments.transliteration: fakhalaqa lahumul-lay-l leeas-kunoo feehee min h'arakaatit-taa'bi
segments.translation: 7.He created for them the night, "that they might rest in it" (10:67) from tiring movements

segments.arabic: وَنَهَضَاتِ النَّصَبِ، وَجَعَلَهُ لِبَاساً لِيَلْبَسُوا مِنْ رَاحَتِهِ وَمَنَامِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa nahaz''aatin-nas'ab wa jaa'lahoo libaasal-leeal-basoo mir-raah'atihee wamanaamihee
segments.translation: 8.and wearisome exertions and He made it a garment for them that they might be clothed in its ease and its sleep,

segments.arabic: فَيَكُونَ ذَلِكَ جَمَاماً وَقُوَّةً، وَلِيَنَالُوا بِهِ لَذَّةً وَشَهْوَةً.
segments.transliteration: fayakoona d'alika lahum jamaamaw-waqoo-wah wa leeanaaloo bihee lad'-d'ataw-washah-wah
segments.translation: 9.that it might be for them refreshment and strength, that they might reach therein pleasure and passion.

segments.arabic: وَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ النَّهارَ مُبْصِراً لِيَبْتَغُوا فِيهِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa khalaqa lahumun-nahaara mub-s'ira leeab-taghoo feehee min faz''-lih
segments.translation: 10.He created for them the daytime, "giving sight, that they might seek within it of His bounty" (ref. 17:12)

segments.arabic: وَلِيَتَسَبَّبُوا  إلَى رِزْقِهِ، وَيَسْرَحُوا فِي أَرْضِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa leeatasab-baboo ilaa riz-qih wa yas-rah'oo feee ar-z''ih
segments.translation: 11.find the means to His provision, and roam freely in His earth,

segments.arabic: طَلَباً لِمَا فِيـهِ نَيْلُ الْعَاجِلِ مِنْ دُنْيَاهُمْ،
segments.transliteration: t'alabal-limaa feeh nay-lul-a'ajili min dunyaahum-
segments.translation: 12.searching for that through which to attain the immediate in their life in this world

segments.arabic: وَدَرَكُ الاجِلِ فِيْ اُخْراهُمْ. بِكُلِّ ذلِكَ يُصْلِحُ شَأنَهُمْ،
segments.transliteration: wa darakul-aaajili feee ukh-raahum- bikul-li d'alika yus'-lihoo shaa-nahum-
segments.translation: 13.and to achieve the deferred in their life to come. Through all of this He sets right their situation,

segments.arabic: وَيَبْلُو أَخْبَارَهُمْ وَيَنْظُرُ كَيْفَ هُمْ فِي أَوْقَاتِ طَاعَتِـهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa yab-looo akh-baarahum- wa yanz'uru kay-fa hum feee aw-qaati t'aaa'tih
segments.translation: 14.tries their records, and watches their state in the times for obeying Him,

segments.transliteration: wa manaazili furooz''ih wa mawaaqii' ah'-kaamih
segments.translation: 15.the waystations of His obligations, and the places of His ordinances,

segments.arabic: لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أسَاءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى.
segments.transliteration: (leeaj-zeeal-lad'eena asaaa-oo bimaa a'miloo wa yaj-zeeal-lad'eena ah'-sanoo bil-h'us-naa)
segments.translation: 16.that He may repay those who do evil with what they have done and repay those who do good with goodness.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَافَلَقْتَ لَنَا مِنَ الإصْبَاحِ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma falakal-h'am-du a'laa maa falaq-ta lanaa minal-is'-baah'
segments.translation: 17.O God, to You belongs praise for the sky You hast split into dawn for us,

segments.transliteration: wa mat-taa'-tanaa bihee min z''aw-in-nahaar
segments.translation: 18.giving us to enjoy thereby the brightness of daytime,

segments.transliteration: wa bas'-s'ar-tanaa mim-mat'aalibil-aq-waat
segments.translation: 19.showing us sought-after nourishments,

segments.transliteration: wa waqay-tanaa feehee min t'awaariqil-aaafaat
segments.translation: 20.and protecting us from the striking of blights.

segments.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَتِ الاَشْياءُ كُلُّهَا بِجُمْلَتِهَا لَكَ:
segments.transliteration: as'-bah'-naa wa as'-bah'atil-ash-yaaa-u kul-luhaa bijum-latihaa lak
segments.translation: 21.In the morning we and all things, every one, rise for You,

segments.transliteration: samaaaw-uhaa wa ar-z''uhaa wa maa bathath-ta
segments.translation: 22.the heaven and the earth and what You hast scattered

segments.arabic: فِي كُلِّ وَاحِد مِنْهُمَا سَاكِنُهُ وَمُتَحَرِّكُهُ وَمُقِيمُهُ
segments.transliteration: fee kul-li waah'idim-min-humaa saakinuhoo wa mutah'ar-rikuh wa muqeemuhoo
segments.translation: 23.in each, the still and the moving, the resident

segments.arabic: وَشَاخِصُهُ وَمَا عَلا فِي الْهَواءِ وَمَا كَنَّ تَحْتَ الثَّرى
segments.transliteration: wa shaakhis'uh wa maa a'laa fil-hawaaa-i wa maa kan-na tah'-tath-tharaa
segments.translation: 24.and the journeying, what towers up in the air and what hides under the ground.

segments.transliteration: as'-bah'-naa fee qab-z''atik
segments.translation: 25.We rise in the morning in Your grasp:

segments.transliteration: yah'-weenaa mul-kuka wa  sul-t'aanuk wa taz''um-munaa mashee-yatuk
segments.translation: 26.Your kingdom and authority contain us and Your will embraces us.

segments.arabic: وَنَتَصَرَّفُ عَنْ أَمْرِكَ، وَنَتَقَلَّبُ فِيْ تَدْبِيرِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa natas'ar-rafu a'n am-rik wa nataqal-labu fee tad-beerik
segments.translation: 27.We move about by Your command and turn this way and that through Your governing.

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ لَنَا مِنَ الامْرِ إلاّ مَا قَضَيْتَ
segments.transliteration: lay-sa lanaa minal-am-ri il-laa maa qaz''ay-t
segments.translation: 28.We own nothing of the affair except what You hast decreed

segments.arabic: وَلا مِنَ الْخَيْـرِ إلا مَـا أَعْطَيْتَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa minal-khay-ri il-laa maaa aa'-t'ay-t
segments.translation: 29.and nothing of the good except what You hast given.

segments.arabic: وَهَذَا يَوْمٌ حَادِثٌ جَدِيدٌ، وَهُوَ عَلَيْنَا شَاهِدٌ عَتِيدٌ ،
segments.transliteration: wa had'aa yaw-mun h'aadithun jadeed wa huwa a'lay-naa shaahidun a'teed
segments.translation: 30.This is a fresh, new day, over us a ready witness.

segments.arabic: إنْ أحْسَنَّا وَدَّعَنَا بِحَمْد، وَإِنْ أسَأنا فارَقَنا بِذَمّ
segments.transliteration: in ah'-san-naa wad-daa'naa bih'am-d wa in asaa-naa faaraqanaa bid'am
segments.translation: 31.If we do good, it will take leave from us with praise, and if we do evil, it will part from us in blame.

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih
segments.translation: 32.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: war-zuq-naa h'us-na mus'aah'abatih wa aa'-s'im-naa
segments.translation: 33.provide us with the day's good companionship and preserve us

segments.transliteration: min sooo-i mufaaraqatih bir-tikaabi jareerah
segments.translation: 34.against parting from it badly by doing a misdeed

segments.transliteration: awi aq-tiraafi s'agheeratin aw kabeerah
segments.translation: 35.or committing a sin, whether small or great!

segments.arabic: وَأجْزِلْ لَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَسَناتِ وَأَخْلِنَا فِيهِ مِنَ السَّيِّئاتِ.
segments.transliteration: wa aj-zil-lanaa feehee minal-h'asanaat wa akh-linaa feehee minas-say-yi-aat
segments.translation: 36.Make our good deeds within it plentiful empty us therein of evil deeds,

segments.arabic: وَامْلا لَنَا مَا بَيْنَ طَرَفَيْهِ حَمْداً وَشُكْراً وَأجْراً وَذُخْراً وَفَضْلاً وَإحْسَاناً.
segments.transliteration: wa am-laa lanaa maa beena t'arafay-hee h'am-daw-washuk-raa wa aj-raw-wa d'ukh-raa wa faz''-law-wa ih'-saanaa
segments.translation: 37.and fill what lies between its two sides for us with praise and thanksgiving, wages and stores, bounty and beneficence!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يسِّرْ عَلَى الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ مَؤُونَتَنَا،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma yas-sir a'laal-kiraamil-kaatibeena maw-unatanaa
segments.translation: 38.O God, ease our burden on the Noble Writers,

segments.transliteration: wa am-laa lanaa min h'asanaatinaa s'ah'aaa-ifanaa
segments.translation: 39.fill our pages for us with our good deeds,

segments.transliteration: wa laa tukh-zinaa i'ndahum bisooo-i aa'-maalinaa
segments.translation: 40.and degrade us not before them with our evil works!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لَنَا فِي كُلِّ سَاعَة مِنْ سَاعَاتِهِ حَظّاً مِنْ عِبَادِكَ ،
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma aj-a'l-lanaa fee kul-li saaa'tim-min saaa'atih h'az'-z'am-min i'baadik
segments.translation: 41.O God, appoint for us in each of the day's hours a share from Your servants,

segments.arabic: وَنَصِيباً مِنْ شُكْرِكَ وَشَاهِدَ صِدْق مِنْ  مَلائِكَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa nas'eebam-min shuk-rik wa shaahida s'id-qim-mim-malaaa-ikatik
segments.translation: 42.a portion of giving thanks to You, and a truthful witness among Your angels!

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih
segments.translation: 43.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَاحْفَظْنَا مِنْ بَيْنِ أيْدِينَا وَمِنْ خَلْفِنَا وَعَنْ أيْمَانِنَا  وَعَنْ شَمَائِلِنَا،
segments.transliteration: wa ah'-faz'-naa mim-bay-ni ay-deenaa? wa min khal-finaa wa a'n ay-maaninaa? wa a'n shamaaa-ilinaa
segments.translation: 44.and safeguard us from before us and behind us, from our right hands and our left hands

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ جَمِيْعِ نَوَاحِيْنَا حِفْظاً عَاصِماً مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa min jameei' nawaah'eenaa h'if-z'aa a'as'imam-mim-maa'-s'eeatik
segments.translation: 45.and from all our directions, a safeguarding that will preserve from disobeying You,

segments.transliteration: haadeean ilaa t'aaa'tik mus-taa'-milal-limah'ab-batik
segments.translation: 46.guide to obeying You, and be employed for Your love!

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih
segments.translation: 47.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَوَفِّقْنَا فِي يَوْمِنَا هذا ولَيْلَتِنَا هذِهِ وَفِي جَمِيعِ أيّامِنَا
segments.transliteration: wa waf-fiq-naa fee yaw-minaa had'aa wa lay-latinaa had'ihi? wa fee jameei' ay-yaaminaa
segments.translation: 48.and give us success in this day of ours, this night of ours, and in all our days,

segments.arabic: لاسْتِعْمَالِ الْخَيْرِ وَهِجْـرَانِ الشَرِّ وَشُكْـرِ ألنِّعَمِ
segments.transliteration: lias-tia'-maalil-khay-r wa hij-raanish-shar wa shuk-rin-nia'm
segments.translation: 49.to employ the good, stay away from the evil, give thanks for favours,

segments.transliteration: wa at-tibaai's-sunan wa mujaanabatil-bidaa'-
segments.translation: 50.follow the Sunna's norms, avoid innovations,

segments.transliteration: wal-am-ri bil-maa'-roof wan-nah-yi a'nil-munkar
segments.translation: 51.enjoin good behaviour, forbid the disapproved,

segments.transliteration: wa h'eeaat'atil-is-laam wa antiqaas'il-baat'ili wa id'-laalih
segments.translation: 52.defend Islam, diminish falsehood and abase it,

segments.transliteration: wa nus'-ratil-h'aq-qi wa ia'-zaazih wa ir-shaadiz''-z''aaal
segments.translation: 53.help the truth and exalt it, guide the misguided,

segments.transliteration: wa mua'awanatiz''-z''ae'ef wa id-raakil-laaheef
segments.translation: 54.assist the weak, and reach out to the troubled!

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih
segments.translation: 55.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

segments.transliteration: waj-a'l-hooo ay-mana yaw-min a'hid-naah
segments.translation: 56.and make this the most fortunate day we have known,

segments.transliteration: wa af-z''ala s'aah'ibin s'ah'ib-naah
segments.translation: 57.the most excellent companion we have accompanied,

segments.transliteration: wa khay-ra waq-tin z'alil-naa feeh
segments.translation: 58.and the best time in which we have lingered!

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أرْضَى مَنْ مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْـلُ وَالنَّهَارُ مِنْ جُمْلَةِ خَلْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l-naa min ar-z''aa mam-mar-ra a'lay-hil-lay-lu wan-nahaaru min jum-lati khal-qik
segments.translation: 59.Place us among the most satisfied of all Your creatures whom night and day have passed by,

segments.transliteration: ash-karahum limaaa aw-lay-ta min-nia'mik
segments.translation: 60.the most thankful of them for the favours You hast done,

segments.transliteration: wa aq-wamahum bimaa sharaa'-ta min sharaaa-ii'k
segments.translation: 61.the firmest of them in the laws You hast set down in the Shari'a,

segments.transliteration: wa aw-qafahum a'm-maa h'ad'-d'ar-ta min-nah-yik
segments.translation: 62.and the most unyielding of them toward the prohibited acts against which You hast cautioned!

segments.arabic: اللَهُمَّ إنِّي اشْهِدُكَ وَكَفَى بِكَ شَهِيداً وَاُشْهِدُ سَمَاءكَ وَأَرْضَكَ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-neee ush-hiduka wa  kafaa bika shaheedaa wa ush-hidu samaaa-aka wa ar-z''aka
segments.translation: 63.O God, I call You to witness - and You art sufficient witness - and I call Your heaven and Your earth to witness

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ أَسْكَنْتَهُما مِنْ مَلائِكَتِـكَ وَسَائِرِ خَلْقِكَ فِي يَوْمِي هَذَا ،
segments.transliteration: wa man as-kantahumaa mim-malaaa-ikatika wa saaa-iri khal-qik fee yaw-mee had'aa
segments.translation: 64.and Your angels and Your other creatures who inhabit them in this my day,

segments.arabic: وَسَاعَتِي هَذِهِ ، وَلَيْلَتِي هَذِهِ ، وَمُسْتَقَرِّي هَذَا ،
segments.transliteration: wa saaa'tee had'ih? wa lay-latee had'ih wa mus-taqar-ree had'aa
segments.translation: 65.this my hour, this my night, and this my resting place,

segments.arabic: أنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أنْتَ اللهُ الِذَّي
segments.transliteration: an-neee ash-hadu an-naka antal-laahool-lad'ee
segments.translation: 66.that I bear witness that You art God,

segments.arabic: لاَ إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ قَائِمٌ بِـالْقِسْطِ ،
segments.transliteration: laaa ilaha il-laaa ant qaaa-imum-bil-qis-t'
segments.translation: 67.other than whom there is no god, Upholding justice,

segments.transliteration: a'd-lun fil-h'uk-m ra-oofum-bil-i'baad
segments.translation: 68.Equitable in judgement, "Clement to the servants" (2:207),

segments.transliteration: maalikul-mul-k rah'eemum-bil-khal-q
segments.translation: 69."Master of the kingdom" (3:26), Compassionate to the creatures,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ وَخِيرَتُكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ ،
segments.transliteration: wa an-na muh'am-madan a'b-duka warasooluk wa kheearatuka min khal-qik
segments.translation: 70.and that Muhammad is Your servant and Your messenger, Your chosen from among Your creatures.

segments.arabic: حَمَّلْتَهُ رِسَالَتَكَ فَأدَّاهَا وَأَمَرْتَهُ بالنُّصْحِ لاُِمَّتِهِ فَنَصَحَ لَهَا.
segments.transliteration: h'am-mal-tahoo risaalataka faad-daahaa wa amar-tahoo bin-nus'-hee lium-matihee fanas'ah'a lahaa
segments.translation: 71.You didst charge him with Your message and he delivered it; You didst command him to counsel his community and he counselled it.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ أكْثَرَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَد مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih ak-thara maa s'al-lay-ta a'laaa ah'adim-min khal-qik
segments.translation: 72.O God, so bless Muhammad and his Household more than You hast blessed any of Your creatures!

segments.arabic: وَآتِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا آتَيْتَ أَحَداً مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa aaatihee a'n-naaa af-z''ala maaa aaatay-ta ah'adam-min i'baadik
segments.translation: 73.Give him for our sake the best You hast given any of Your servants,

segments.arabic: وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ وَأكْرَمَ مَا جَزَيْتَ أَحَداً مِنْ أَنْبِيائِـكَ  عَنْ أمَّتِهِ.
segments.transliteration: wa aj-zihee a'n-naaa af-z''ala wa ak-rama maa jazay-ta ah'adam-min ambeeaaa-ika a'n um-matih
segments.translation: 74.and repay him on our behalf better and more generously than You hast repaid any of Your prophets on behalf of his community!

segments.arabic: إنَّـكَ أَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بِالْجَسِيمِ الْغَـافِر لِلْعَظِيمِ ،
segments.transliteration: in-nak antal-man-naanu bil-jaseem wa al-ghaafiru lil-a'z'eem
segments.translation: 75.You art All-kind with immensity, the Forgiver of the great,

segments.transliteration: wa anta ar-h'amu min kul-li rah'eem
segments.translation: 76.and You art more merciful than every possessor of mercy!

segments.transliteration: fas'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalihi
segments.translation: 77.So bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.transliteration: t'ay-yibeenat'-t'aahireenal-akh-yaaril-anjabeen
segments.translation: 78.the good, the pure, the chosen, the most distinguished!

segments.arabic: أَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهارَ بِقُوَّتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: Al-á¸¥amdu lillÄhi alladhÄ« khalaqa al-layla wa an-nahÄra bi quwwatihi,
segments.translation: Praise be to Allah who created the night and the day by His power,

segments.transliteration: Wa mayyaza baynahumÄ bi qudratihi,
segments.translation: And distinguished between them by His ability,

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلَ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا حَدًّا مَحْدُودًا، وَأَمَدًا مَمْدُودًا،
segments.transliteration: Wa jaÊ¿ala likulli wÄá¸¥idin minhumÄ á¸¥addan maá¸¥dÅ«dan wa amadan mamdÅ«dan,
segments.translation: And made for each of them a fixed limit and an extended time,

segments.arabic: يُولِجُ كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا فِيْ صَاحِبِهِ،
segments.transliteration: YÅ«liju kulla wÄá¸¥idin minhumÄ fÄ« á¹£Äá¸¥ibihi,
segments.translation: He causes each of them to enter its companion,

segments.arabic: وَيُولِجُ صَاحِبَهُ فِيهِ بِتَقْدِيرٍ مِنْهُ لِلْعِبَادِ
segments.transliteration: Wa yÅ«liju á¹£Äá¸¥ibahu fÄ«hi bi taqdÄ«rin minhu lil-Ê¿ibÄd,
segments.translation: And causes its companion to enter it by decree from Him for the servants,

segments.transliteration: FÄ«mÄ yughdhÅ«hum bihi wa yunshiâuhum Ê¿alayh,
segments.translation: In that with which He nourishes them and raises them,

segments.arabic: فَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا فِيهِ مِنْ حَرَكَاتِ التَّعَبِ،
segments.transliteration: Fa khalaqa lahumu al-layla liyas kunÅ« fÄ«hi min á¸¥arakÄti at-taÊ¿ab,
segments.translation: So He created the night for them to rest in it from labor,

segments.arabic: وَنَهَضَاتِ النَّصَبِ، وَجَعَلَهُ لِبَاسًا لِيَلْبَسُوا مِنْ رَاحَتِهِ وَمَنَامِهِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa nahadhÄti an-naá¹£ab, wa jaÊ¿alahu libÄsan li yalbasÅ« min rÄá¸¥atihi wa manÄmihi,
segments.translation: And from the exertion they rise from, and made it a garment to wear for comfort and sleep,

segments.arabic: فَيَكُونَ ذَلِكَ جَمَامًا وَقُوَّةً، وَلِيَنَالُوا بِهِ لَذَّةً وَشَهْوَةً.
segments.transliteration: FayakÅ«na dhÄlika jamÄman wa quwwatan, wa li yanÄlÅ« bihi ladhdhatan wa shahwata,
segments.translation: Thus it is rest and strength, so they may attain by it pleasure and desire.

segments.arabic: وَخَلَقَ لَهُمُ النَّهارَ مُبْصِرًا لِيَبْتَغُوا فِيهِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa khalaqa lahumu an-nahÄra mubá¹£iran li yabtaghÅ« fÄ«hi min faá¸lihi,
segments.translation: And He created the day for them as sight to seek from His bounty,

segments.arabic: وَلِيَتَسَبَّبُوا إِلَى رِزْقِهِ، وَيَسْرَحُوا فِي أَرْضِهِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa li yatasabbabÅ« ilÄ rizqihi, wa yasrahÅ« fÄ« ará¸ihi,
segments.translation: And so they may endeavor to earn their provision, and wander on His earth,

segments.arabic: طَلَبًا لِمَا فِيهِ نَيْلُ الْعَاجِلِ مِنْ دُنْيَاهُمْ،
segments.transliteration: á¹¬alaban limÄ fÄ«hi naylu al-Ê¿Äjili min dunyÄhum,
segments.translation: Seeking what attains the immediate benefit from their worldly life,

segments.transliteration: Wa daraku al-ajli fÄ« ukhrÄhum.
segments.translation: And the reaching of the last time in their Hereafter.

segments.transliteration: Bi kulli dhÄlik yuá¹£liá¸¥u shaÊ¾nahum,
segments.translation: With all that He sets their affairs right,

segments.arabic: وَيَبْلُو أَخْبَارَهُمْ وَيَنْظُرُ كَيْفَ هُمْ فِي أَوْقَاتِ طَاعَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: Wa yablÅ« akhbÄrahum wa yanáºur kayfa hum fÄ« awqÄti á¹­ÄÊ¿atihi,
segments.translation: And tests their stories and watches how they fare in times of obedience to Him,

segments.transliteration: Wa manÄzili furÅ«á¸ihi wa mawÄqiÊ¿i aá¸¥kÄmihi,
segments.translation: And the stations of His duties and places of His judgments,

segments.arabic: لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسَاءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى.
segments.transliteration: LiyajzÄ« al-ladhÄ«na asÄÅ« bimÄ Ê¿amilÅ« wa yajzÄ« al-ladhÄ«na aá¸¥sanÅ« bil-á¸¥usnÄ.
segments.translation: To recompense those who did evil by what they did, and those who did good with the best.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا فَلَقْتَ لَنَا مِنَ الإِصْبَاحِ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma falaka al-á¸¥amdu Ê¿alÄ mÄ falaqta lanÄ mina al-iá¹£bÄá¸¥,
segments.translation: O Allah, to You be the praise for what You have dawned upon us this morning,

segments.transliteration: Wa mattaÊ¿nÄ bihi min á¸awâi an-nahÄr,
segments.translation: And gave us the enjoyment of the daylight,

segments.transliteration: Wa baá¹£á¹£artnÄ min maá¹­Älib al-aqwÄt,
segments.translation: And made us discerning in seeking provision,

segments.transliteration: Wa waqaytanÄ fÄ«hi min á¹­awÄriqi al-ÄfÄt,
segments.translation: And protected us in it from the attacks of calamities.

segments.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَتِ الْأَشْيَاءُ كُلُّهَا بِجُمْلَتِهَا لَكَ:
segments.transliteration: Aá¹£baá¸¥nÄ wa aá¹£baá¸¥at al-ashyÄÊ¾u kulluhÄ bijumlatihÄ laka:
segments.translation: We have entered the morning, and all things in their entirety belong to You:

segments.transliteration: SamÄÊ¾uhÄ wa ará¸uhÄ wa mÄ bathatha
segments.translation: Its sky, its earth, and whatever You have spread,

segments.arabic: فِي كُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا سَاكِنُهُ وَمُتَحَرِّكُهُ وَمُقِيمُهُ،
segments.transliteration: FÄ« kulli wÄá¸¥idin minhumÄ sÄkinuhu wa mutaá¸¥arrikuhu wa muqÄ«muhu,
segments.translation: In each one of them its rest, its movement, and its permanence,

segments.arabic: وَشَاخِصُهُ وَمَا عَلَا فِي الْهَوَاءِ وَمَا كَنَّ تَحْتَ الثَّرَى،
segments.transliteration: Wa shÄkhiá¹£uhu wa mÄ Ê¿alÄ fÄ« al-hawÄâ wa mÄ kanna taá¸¥ta ath-tharÄ,
segments.translation: And its fixed points, that which is in the air and that which is beneath the earth,

segments.transliteration: Aá¹£baá¸¥nÄ fÄ« qabá¸atika
segments.translation: We have entered into Your grasp;

segments.transliteration: Yaá¸¥wÄ«nÄ mulkuka wa sulá¹­Änuka wa taá¸ummunÄ mashÄ«yatuka,
segments.translation: Your kingdom surrounds us, Your authority, and Your will encloses us,

segments.arabic: وَنَتَصَرَّفُ عَنْ أَمْرِكَ، وَنَتَقَلَّبُ فِي تَدْبِيرِكَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa nataá¹£arrafu Ê¿an amrika, wa nataqallabu fÄ« tadbÄ«rika,
segments.translation: Yet we act by Your command and turn within Your management,

segments.arabic: لَيْسَ لَنَا مِنَ الْأَمْرِ إِلَّا مَا قَضَيْتَ،
segments.transliteration: Laysa lanÄ mina al-amri illÄ mÄ qaá¸ayta,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاقْضِ لَنَا فِي الْخَيْرِ، وَاجْعَلْ لَنَا مَوْطِناً فِي الصِّدْقِ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma faqá¸i lanÄ fÄ« al-khayr, wa-ajâal lanÄ mawá¹­inan fÄ« al-á¹£idq,
segments.translation: O Allah, decree goodness for us and grant us a place in truth,

segments.transliteration: wa-anzilnÄ fÄ« dÄri al-muqÄmah wa-al-raá¸¥mah,
segments.translation: And settle us in the abode of permanence and mercy,

segments.arabic: وَارْزُقْنَا الْفَوْزَ بِالْجَنَّةِ، وَالنَّجَاةَ مِنَ النَّارِ.
segments.transliteration: wa-arzuqnÄ al-fawza bi-al-jannah, wa-al-najÄta mina al-nÄr,
segments.translation: And grant us success in attaining Paradise and salvation from the Fire.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسِنْ عَاقِبَتَنَا فِي الأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma aá¸¥sin âÄqibatana fÄ« al-umÅ«ri kullihÄ,
segments.translation: O Allah, grant us a good outcome in all our affairs,

segments.arabic: وَأَجِرْنَا مِنْ خِزْيِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الآخِرَةِ.
segments.transliteration: wa-ajirnÄ min khizy al-dunyÄ wa-âadhÄbi al-Äkhirah,
segments.translation: And save us from the disgrace of this world and the punishment of the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اقْسِمْ لَنَا مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ مَا يَحُولُ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ مَعَاصِيكَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma aqsim lanÄ min khashyatika mÄ yaá¸¥Å«lu baynanÄ wa-bayna maâÄá¹£Ä«k,
segments.translation: O Allah, grant us a share of Your reverence that keeps us away from disobeying You,

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا تُبَلِّغُنَا بِهِ جَنَّتَكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa-min á¹­Äâatika mÄ tuballighunÄ bihi jannatak,
segments.translation: And from Your obedience what will lead us to Your Paradise,

segments.arabic: وَمِنَ الْيَقِينِ مَا تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا مُصِيبَاتِ الدُّنْيَا.
segments.transliteration: wa-min al-yaqÄ«n mÄ tuhawwinu bihi âalaynÄ muá¹£Ä«bÄti al-dunyÄ,
segments.translation: And from certainty what makes the trials of this world easy for us.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَتِّعْنَا بِأَسْمَاعِنَا، وَأَبْصَارِنَا، وَقُوَّاتِنَا مَا أَحْيَيْتَنَا،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma mattiânÄ bi-asmÄâinÄ, wa-abá¹£ÄrinÄ, wa-quwwÄtinÄ mÄ aá¸¥yaytanÄ,
segments.translation: O Allah, bless us with the use of our hearing, sight, and strength as long as we live,

segments.transliteration: wa-ajâalhu al-wÄritha minnÄ,
segments.translation: And make them last until our end,

segments.transliteration: wa-ajâal thaârana âala man áºalamanÄ,
segments.translation: And let our vengeance be against those who wrong us,

segments.transliteration: wa-aná¹£urnÄ âala man âÄdÄnÄ,
segments.translation: And grant us victory over those who oppose us.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْ مُصِيبَتَنَا فِي دِينِنَا،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma lÄ tajâal muá¹£Ä«batana fÄ« dÄ«nina,
segments.translation: O Allah, do not make our affliction in our religion,

segments.arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلِ الدُّنْيَا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّنَا، وَلاَ مَبْلَغَ عِلْمِنَا،
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ tajâali al-dunyÄ akbara hammÄ«nÄ, wa-lÄ mablagha âilminÄ,
segments.translation: And do not make this world our greatest concern or the extent of our knowledge,

segments.arabic: وَلَا تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمُنَا.
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ tusalliá¹­ âalaynÄ man lÄ yará¸¥amunÄ,
segments.translation: And do not place over us those who do not have mercy on us.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَدَعْ لَنَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ ذَنْبًا إِلَّا غَفَرْتَهُ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma lÄ tadaâ lanÄ fÄ« hÄdhÄ al-yawmi dhanban illÄ ghafartahu,
segments.translation: O Allah, do not leave for us any sin on this day except that You forgive it,

segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ hamman illÄ farrjtahu,
segments.translation: Nor any worry except that You relieve it,

segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ daynan illÄ qaá¸aytahu,
segments.translation: Nor any debt except that You settle it,

segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ marÄ«á¸an illÄ shafaytahu,
segments.translation: Nor any sick person except that You heal him,

segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ mubtalÄn illÄ âÄfaytahu,
segments.translation: Nor any afflicted person except that You grant him well-being,

segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ mayyitan illÄ raá¸¥imtahu,
segments.translation: Nor any deceased except that You have mercy on him,

segments.arabic: وَلَا حَاجَةً مِنْ حَوَائِجِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ،
segments.transliteration: wa-lÄ á¸¥Äjatan min á¸¥awÄâiji al-dunyÄ wa-al-Äkhirah,
segments.translation: Nor any need of this world or the Hereafter,

segments.arabic: إِلَّا قَضَيْتَهَا وَيَسَّرْتَهَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
segments.transliteration: illÄ qaá¸aytahÄ wa-yassartahÄ bi-raá¸¥matika yÄ ará¸¥ama al-rÄá¸¥imÄ«n,
segments.translation: Except that You fulfill it and make it easy by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَآلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli âala Muá¸¥ammadin wa-Äli Muá¸¥ammad kamÄ á¹£allayta âala IbrÄhÄ«ma wa-Äli IbrÄhÄ«m,
segments.translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim,

segments.transliteration: innaka á¸¥amÄ«dun majÄ«d,
segments.translation: Indeed, You are the Most Praiseworthy, the Most Glorious.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammadin wa Älihi

segments.arabic: وَاكْفِنَا طُولَ الْأَمَلِ وَقَصِّرْهُ عَنَّا بِصِدْقِ الْعَمَلِ

segments.transliteration: á¸¥attÄ lÄ nuÊ¾ammila istitmÄma sÄÊ¿atin baÊ¿da sÄÊ¿atin
segments.translation: so we do not hope to complete one hour after another,

segments.transliteration: wa lÄ istÄ«fÄÊ¾a yawmin baÊ¿da yawmin
segments.translation: nor to fulfill one day after another,

segments.transliteration: wa lÄ ttiá¹£Äla nafasin binafasin

segments.transliteration: wa lÄ luá¸¥Å«qa qadamin biqadamin

segments.arabic: وَسَلِّمْنَا مِنْ غُرُورِهِ وَآمِنَّا مِنْ شُرُورِهِ

segments.transliteration: wa ná¹£ibi l-mawta bayna aydÄ«nÄ naá¹£ban

segments.transliteration: wa lÄ tajÊ¿al dhikranÄ lahu ghibban

segments.transliteration: wa jÊ¿al lanÄ min á¹£Äliá¸¥i l-aÊ¿mÄli
segments.translation: Grant us from righteous deeds

segments.transliteration: Ê¿amalan nastabá¹­iÊ¾u maÊ¿ahu l-maá¹£Ä«ra ilayka
segments.translation: a deed that makes us slow to reach You,

segments.arabic: وَنَحْرِصُ لَهُ عَلَى وَشْكِ اللِّحَاقِ بِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa naá¸¥riá¹£u lahu Ê¿alÄ washki l-liá¸¥Äqi bika
segments.translation: and eager to hasten toward You,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى يَكُونَ الْمَوْتُ مَأْنَسَنَا الَّذِي نَأْنَسُ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: á¸¥attÄ yakÅ«na l-mawtu maÊ¾nasanÄ lladhÄ« naÊ¾nasu bihi
segments.translation: so that death becomes our intimate with which we are familiar,

segments.transliteration: wa maÊ¾lafanÄ lladhÄ« nashtÄqu ilayhi
segments.translation: our acquaintance we long for,

segments.transliteration: wa á¸¥Ämmatana llatÄ« nuá¸¥ibbu d-dunÅ«wa minhÄ
segments.translation: and our beloved we love to approach.

segments.transliteration: fa idhÄ awradtahu Ê¿alaynÄ wa anzaltahu binÄ
segments.translation: When You bring it upon us and send it down to us,

segments.arabic: فَأَسْعِدْنَا بِهِ زَائِرًا وَآنِسْنَا بِهِ قَادِمًا
segments.transliteration: fa asÊ¿idnÄ bihi zÄÊ¾iran wa ÄnisnÄ bihi qÄdiman

segments.arabic: وَلَا تُشْقِنَا بِضِيَافَتِهِ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا بِزِيَارَتِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa lÄ tushqinÄ biá¸iyÄfatihi wa lÄ tukhzÄ«nÄ biziyÄratihi
segments.translation: do not make us wretched by hosting it or disgrace us by its visit.

segments.transliteration: wa jÊ¿alhu bÄban min abwÄbi maghfiratika

segments.transliteration: wa miftÄá¸¥an min mafÄtÄ«á¸¥i raá¸¥matika

segments.transliteration: amitnÄ muhtadÄ«na ghayra á¸ÄllÄ«na

segments.transliteration: á¹­ÄÊ¾iÊ¿Ä«na ghayra mustakrihÄ«na

segments.transliteration: tÄÊ¾ibÄ«na ghayra Ê¿Äá¹£Ä«na wa lÄ muá¹£irrÄ«na

segments.transliteration: yÄ á¸Ämina jazÄÊ¾i l-muá¸¥sinÄ«na
segments.translation: O Guarantor of the reward of the righteous,

segments.transliteration: wa mustaá¹£liá¸¥a Ê¿amali l-mufsidÄ«na
segments.translation: and Reformer of the deeds of the corrupt!

segments.transliteration: al-laahum-ma s'al-li a'laa muh'am-madiw-wa aaalih
segments.translation: 1.O God, Bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَاكْفِنَا طُـولَ الأمَـلِ، وَقَصِّرْهُ عَنَّا بِصِدْقِ الْعَمَلِ
segments.transliteration: wak-finaa t'oolal-amal wa qas'-s'ir-hoo a'n-naa bis'id-qil-a'mal
segments.translation: 2.spare us drawn out expectations and cut them short in us through sincerity of works,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى لا نُؤَمِّلَ اسْتِتْمَامَ سَاعَةٍ بَعْدَ سَاعَةٍ
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa laa noo-am-mila is-tit-maama saaa'tim-baa'-da saaa'h
segments.translation: 3.that we may not hope expectantly for completing an hour after an hour,

segments.transliteration: wa laa as-teefaaa-a yaw-mim-baa'-da yaw-m
segments.translation: 4.closing a day after a day,

segments.transliteration: wa laa at-tis'aala nafasim-binafas
segments.translation: 5.joining a breath to a breath,

segments.transliteration: wa laa luh'ooqa qadamim-biqadam
segments.translation: 6.or overtaking a step with a step!

segments.arabic: وَسَلِّمْنَا مِنْ غُرُورِهِ، وَآمَنَّا مِنْ شُـرُوْرِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa sal-lim-naa min ghuroorih wa aaamin-naa min shuroorih
segments.translation: 7.Keep us safe from the delusions of expectations, make us secure from their evils,

segments.transliteration: wans'ibil-maw-ta bay-na ay-deenaa nas'-baa
segments.translation: 8.set up death before us in display.

segments.transliteration: wa laa taj-a'l d'ik-ranaa lahoo ghib-baa
segments.translation: 9.and let not our remembering of it come and go!

segments.transliteration: waj-a'l-lanaa min s'aalih'il-aa'-maali
segments.translation: 10.Appoint for us from among the righteous works

segments.transliteration: a'malana nas-tab-t'i-u maa'hul-mas'eera ilay-k
segments.translation: 11.a work through which we will feel the homecoming to You as slow

segments.arabic: وَنحْـرِصُ لَهُ عَلَى وَشْكِ اللِّحَاقِ بِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa nah'-ris'u lahoo a'laa wash-kil-lah'aaqi bik
segments.translation: 12.and crave a quick joining with You,

segments.arabic: حَتَّى يَكُونَ الْمَوْتُ مَأنَسَنَا الَّذِي نَأنَسُ بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: h'at-taa yakoonal-maw-t maa-nasanaal-lad'ee naa-nasu bih
segments.translation: 13.so that death may be our intimate abode with which we are intimate,

segments.arabic: وَمَألَفَنَا الَّذِي نَشْتَاقُ إلَيْهِ، وَحَامَّتَنَا الَّتِي نُحِبُّ الدُّنُوَّ مِنْهَا
segments.transliteration: wa maa-lafanaal-lad'ee nash-taaqu ilay-h wa h'aaam-matanaal-latee nuh'ib-bud-dunoo-wa min-haa
segments.translation: 14.our familiar place toward which we yearn, and our next of kin whose coming we love!

segments.transliteration: fa id'aaa aw-rat-tahoo a'lay-naa wa anzal-tahoo binaa
segments.translation: 15.When You bringest it to us and sendest it down upon us,

segments.arabic: فَأسْعِدْنَا بِهِ زَائِراً، وَآنِسْنَا بِهِ قَادِماً،
segments.transliteration: faas-i'd-naa bihee zaaa-iraa wa aaanis-naa bihee qaadimaa
segments.translation: 16.make us happy with it as a visitor, comfort us with its arrival,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تُشْقِنَا بِضِيافَتِهِ، وَلا تُخْزِنَا بِزِيارَتِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa tush-qinaa biz''eeaafatih wa laa tukh-zinaa bizeeaaratih
segments.translation: 17.make us not wretched through entertaining it, degrade us not through its visit,

segments.transliteration: waj-a'l-hoo baabam-min ab-waabi magh-firatik
segments.translation: 18.and appoint it one of the gates to Your forgiveness

segments.transliteration: wa mif-taah'am-mim-mafaateehee rah'-matik
segments.translation: 19.and the keys to Your mercy!

segments.transliteration: amit-naa muh-tadeena ghay-ra z''aaal-leen
segments.translation: 20.Make us die guided, not astray,

segments.arabic: طائِعِينَ غَيْرَ مُسْتَكْرِهِينَ تَائِبينَ غَيْرَ عاصِينَ وَلا مُصِرِّينَ
segments.transliteration: t'aaa-ie'ena ghay-ra mus-tak-riheen taaa-ibeena ghay-ra a'as'eena wa laa mus'ir-reen
segments.translation: 21.obedient, not averse, repentant, not disobedient or persisting,

segments.transliteration: yaa z''aamina jazaaa-il-muh'-sineen
segments.translation: 22.O He who guarantees the repayment of the good-doers

segments.transliteration: wa mus-tas'-lih'a a'malil-muf-sideen
segments.translation: 23.and seeks to set right the work of the corrupt!

title: Hazrat Abbas Ibn Ali ( peace be upon him)
text: Hazrat Abbas Ibn Ali ( peace be upon him)       Ziyarat Hazrat Abbas Ibn Ali(as) Brief info Brief Life × BRotherhood, Courage, and Loyalty in Abbas bin Ali - By SAYYID MUHAMMAD RIZVI Who was Abbas (peace be upon him), whose birth anniversary is being celebrated this week? To the Muslims, Abbas is known in different ways: as the lion of Ali, the hero of Karbala, the flag-bearer of Hussain, the beloved brother of Zainab, and the loving uncle of Sakina (peace be upon them all). Abbas was the son of Imam Ali, the first Imam and successor of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his progeny). He was the brother of Imam Hussain. Fifty years after the demise of the Prophet Muhammad, his grandson Hussain stood up against Yazid, the tyrant ruler of the time, and refused to pledge allegiance to him. As a result of this protest, Hussain, his family-members, and a small group of his companions were surrounded by Yazidi forces in the desert of Karbala, prevented from water for three days, and, finally, on the Day of Ashura, Hussain with about 100 souls faced an army of 25,000 soldiers. They were given the choice of pledging allegiance to Yazid or face death. In that uneven battle, Hussain chose an honorable death over a disgraceful life under a tyrant like Yazid. It was in that historical event that Abbas was made the commander-in-chief and flag-bearer of Hussaini forces. That battle-field gradually turned into a place of pilgrimage, and today the shrines of both these brothers, with their golden domes, form the skyline of Karbala in Iraq. Brotherhood By his supreme sacrifice, Abbas became a universal soul that transcends time and space. Let us start with concept of brotherhood: Brotherhood can be understood on two different levels, a physical and personal level, and a spiritual and social level. Both aspects are important. segments.transliteration: salamu allahi wa salamu mala'ikatihi almuqarrabina
segments.translation: O he who saw al-`Abbas attacking the groups of the sheep-like enemies,

segments.transliteration: wa anbiya'ihi almursalina
segments.translation: followed by the sons of Haydar, who were as courageous as lions.

segments.transliteration: wa `ibadihi alssalihina
segments.translation: I have been told that my son was stricken on the head and had his hand cut!

segments.transliteration: wa jami`i alshshuhada'i walssiddiqina
segments.translation: Woe me for my young lion! Did the stroke of the iron post bow his head?

segments.transliteration: walzzakiyatu alttayyibatu fima taghtadi wa taruhu
segments.translation: Had his sword been in his hand, none could have ever approached him.

segments.arabic:
ـبَ بِرَأْسِهِ مَقْطُوعَ يَدْ
وَيْلِي عَلَىٰ شِبْلي أَمَا
لَ بِرَأْسِهِ ضَرْبُ ٱلْعَمَدْ
لَوْ كانَ سَيْفُكَ فِي يَدَيْـ
ـكَ لَما دَنا مِنْهُ أَحَدْ
segments.transliteration: `alayka yabna amiri almu'minina
segments.translation: Do not call me Ummuâl-Banin (Mother of the sons).

segments.transliteration: ashhadu laka bilttaslimi walttasdiqi
segments.translation: You will remind me of the lions of the lair.

segments.transliteration: walwafa'i walnnasihati
segments.translation: I had sons by whom I was called,

segments.transliteration: likhalafi alnnabiyyi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi almursali
segments.translation: but today, I have no single son!

segments.transliteration: walssibti almuntajabi
segments.translation: They were four; like eagles on heights.

segments.transliteration: walddalili al`alimi
segments.translation: They faced death by having their aorta cut off.

segments.transliteration: walwasiyyi almuballighi
segments.translation: The ravenous lances crowded on their bodies.

segments.transliteration: walmazlumi almuhtadami
segments.translation: So, all of them were pierced and stabbed.

segments.transliteration: fajazaka allahu `an rasulihi
segments.translation: Great is my distress! Is it true what they have told

segments.transliteration: wa `an amiri almu'minina
segments.translation: that `Abbasâs right hand was severed?

segments.transliteration: wa `an alhasani walhusayni
segments.translation: Peace of Allah and peace of His favorite angels,

segments.transliteration: salawatu allahi `alayhim
segments.translation: His commissioned prophets,

segments.transliteration: afdala aljaza'i
segments.translation: His righteous servants,

segments.transliteration: bima sabarta wahtasabta wa a`anta
segments.translation: all the martyrs, and all the veracious (ones),

segments.transliteration: fani`ma `uqba alddari
segments.translation: and also pure, true blessings that come and go,

segments.transliteration: la`ana allahu man qatalaka
segments.translation: be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.

segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man jahila haqqaka
segments.translation: I testify to you of submission (to the will of God), honest acceptance as true,

segments.transliteration: wastakhaffa bihurmatika
segments.translation: loyalty, and sincerity

segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man hala baynaka wa bayna ma'i alfurati
segments.translation: to the descendant of the commissioned Prophet, Allahâs blessings be upon him and his Household,

segments.arabic: لِخَلَفِ ٱلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِ
segments.transliteration: ashhadu annaka qutilta mazluman
segments.translation: the chosen grandson (of the Prophet),

segments.transliteration: wa anna allaha munjizun lakum ma wa`adakum
segments.translation: the well knowledgeable guide (to the true religion),

segments.transliteration: ji'tuka yabna amiri almu'minina wafidan ilaykum
segments.translation: the conveying successor,

segments.transliteration: wa qalbi musallimun lakum wa tabi`un
segments.translation: and the wrongfully oppressed one.

segments.transliteration: wa ana lakum tabi`un
segments.translation: So, Allah may reward you on behalf of His Messenger,

segments.transliteration: wa nusrati lakum mu`addatun
segments.translation: the Commander of the Faithful,

segments.transliteration: hatta yahkuma allahu
segments.translation: al-Hasan, and al-Husayn,

segments.transliteration: wa huwa khayru alhakimina
segments.translation: peace of Allah be upon them,

segments.transliteration: fama`akum ma`akum
segments.translation: with the best reward

segments.transliteration: la ma`a `aduwwikum
segments.translation: for your steadfastness, dedication (to the sake of God), and support (for the right party).

segments.transliteration: inni bikum wa bi'iyabikum min almu'minina
segments.translation: Very excellent be the reward of the eternal life.

segments.transliteration: wa biman khalafakum wa qatalakum min alkafirina
segments.translation: Allahâs curse be on him who killed you.

segments.transliteration: qatala allahu ummatan qatalatkum bil-aidi wal-alsuni
segments.translation: Allahâs curse be on him who ignored your position

segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ayyuha al`abdu alssalihu
segments.translation: and belittled your sanctity.

segments.transliteration: almuti`u lillahi wa lirasulihi wa li'amiri almu'minina
segments.translation: Allahâs curse be on him who precluded you from having from the water of the Euphrates.

segments.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ حَالَ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ مَاءِ ٱلْفُرَاتِ
segments.transliteration: walhasani walhusayni salla allahu `alayhim wa sallama
segments.translation: I testify that you were killed wrongfully

segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
segments.translation: and that Allah will verily fulfill His promise that He made with you.

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُنْجِزٌ لَكُمْ مَا وَعَدَكُمْ
segments.transliteration: wa maghfiratuhu wa ridwanuhu wa `ala ruhika wa badanika
segments.translation: O son of the Commander of the Faithful, I have come to you to present myself before you.

segments.arabic: جِئْتُكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلُمْؤْمِنينَ وَافِداً إِلَيْكُمْ
segments.transliteration: ashhadu wa ushhidu allaha annaka madayta `ala ma mada bihi albadriyyuna
segments.translation: My heart is submissive to you and is following you.

segments.transliteration: walmujahiduna fi sabili allahi
segments.translation: And I am your follower.

segments.transliteration: almunasihuna lahu fi jihadi a`da'ihi
segments.translation: I am ready to support you

segments.transliteration: almubalighuna fi nusrati awliya'ihi
segments.translation: until Allah decides.

segments.transliteration: aldhdhabbuna `an ahibba'ihi
segments.translation: He is surely the best of all those who decide.

segments.transliteration: fajazaka allahu afdala aljaza'i
segments.translation: I am verily with you,

segments.transliteration: wa akthara aljaza'i
segments.translation: not with your enemy.

segments.transliteration: wa awfara aljaza'i
segments.translation: I am one of those who believe in you and believe in your Return.

segments.transliteration: wa awfa jaza'i ahadin mimman wa fa bibay`atihi
segments.translation: I also one of those who deny your opposites and killers.

segments.transliteration: wastajaba lahu da`watahu
segments.translation: Allah may kill the group who killed you with hands and tongues (by giving orders of killing you.)

segments.arabic: قَتَلَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً قَتَلَتْكُمْ بِٱلأَيْدِي وَٱلأَلْسُنِ
segments.transliteration: wa ata`a wulata amrihi
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O righteous servant (of Allah)

segments.transliteration: ashhadu annaka qad balaghta fi alnnasihati
segments.translation: and obedient to Allah, to His Messenger, to the Commander of the Faithful,

segments.transliteration: wa a`tayta ghayata almajhudi
segments.translation: to al-Hasan, and to al-Husayn, peace and greetings of Allah be upon them.

segments.arabic: وَٱلحَسَنِ وَٱلحُسَيْنِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَسَلَّمَ
segments.transliteration: faba`athaka allahu fi alshshuhada'i
segments.translation: Peace, Allahâs mercy, blessings,

segments.transliteration: wa ja`ala ruhaka ma`a arwahi alssu`ada'i
segments.translation: forgiveness, and gratifications be upon you, your soul, and your body.

segments.transliteration: wa a`taka min jinanihi afsahaha manzilan
segments.translation: I testify, and call Allah to witness, that you abided by the same course that was taken by the warriors of (the battle of) Badr

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ وَأُشْهِدُ ٱللَّهَ أَنَّكَ مَضَيْتَ عَلَىٰ مَا مَضَىٰ بِهِ ٱلبَدْرِيُّونَ
segments.transliteration: wa afdalaha ghurafan
segments.translation: and the strivers for Allahâs sake

segments.transliteration: wa rafa`a dhikraka fi `illiyyina
segments.translation: who sincerely served Him in the battlefields against His enemies,

segments.transliteration: wa hasharaka ma`a alnnabiyyina walssiddiqina
segments.translation: did their bests for supporting His disciples,

segments.transliteration: walshshuhada'i walssalihina
segments.translation: and defended His intimate ones.

segments.transliteration: wa hasuna ula'ika rafiqan
segments.translation: So, Allah may reward you the best,

segments.transliteration: ashhadu annaka lam tahin wa lam tankul
segments.translation: the maximum,

segments.transliteration: wa annaka madayta `ala basiratin min amrika
segments.translation: the most abundant,

segments.transliteration: muqtadiyan bilssalihina
segments.translation: and the most conclusive reward that He may give to any one who fulfills his homage,

segments.arabic: وَأَوْفَىٰ جَزَاءِ أَحَدٍ مِمَّنْ وَفَىٰ بِبَيْعَتِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa muttabi`an lilnnabiyyina
segments.translation: answers the call (of the religion),

segments.transliteration: fajama`a allahu baynana wa baynaka
segments.translation: and obeys his (divinely elected) leaders.

segments.transliteration: wa bayna rasulihi wa awliya'ihi
segments.translation: I testify that you acted extremely sincerely

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ قَدْ بَالَغْتَ فِي ٱلنَّصِيحَةِ
segments.transliteration: fi manazili almukhbitina
segments.translation: and exerted all your efforts (in this regard).

segments.transliteration: fa'innahu arhamu alrrahimina
segments.translation: Allah may attach you to the martyrs,

segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: add your soul to the souls of the happy ones,

segments.transliteration: wa la tada` li fi hadha almakani almukarrami walmashhadi almu`azzami dhanban illa ghafartahu
segments.translation: give you the largest abode in His Paradise

segments.transliteration: wa la hamman illa farrjtahu
segments.translation: and the most handsome room,

segments.transliteration: wa la maradan illa shafaytahu
segments.translation: exalt your mention in `Illiyyin (the most elevated position),

segments.transliteration: wa la `ayban illa satartahu
segments.translation: and join you to the Prophets, the veracious ones,

segments.transliteration: wa la rizqan illa basattahu
segments.translation: the martyrs, and the righteous ones.

segments.transliteration: wa la khawfan illa amantahu
segments.translation: Very excellent is the companionship of such ones.

segments.transliteration: wa la shamlan illa jama`tahu
segments.translation: I testify that you did not lag behind and did not turn away the face,

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ لَمْ تَهِنْ وَلَمْ تَنْكُلْ
segments.transliteration: wa la gha'iban illa hafiztahu wa adnaytahu
segments.translation: and that you left this life with full awareness of the truth,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ مَضَيْتَ عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ مِنْ أَمْرِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa la hajatan min hawa'iji alddunya wal-akhirati
segments.translation: following the examples of the righteous ones

segments.transliteration: laka fiha ridan wa liya fiha salahun
segments.translation: and sticking to the Prophets.

segments.transliteration: illa qadaytaha ya arhama alrrahimina
segments.translation: So, Allah may gather us with you,

segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya aba alfadli al`abbasa ibna amiri almu'minina
segments.translation: with His Messenger, and with His disciples

segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka yabna sayyidi alwasiyyina
segments.translation: in the abodes of those who practiced humbly (with their Lord).

segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka yabna awwali alqawmi islaman
segments.translation: He is certainly the most merciful of all the merciful ones.

segments.transliteration: wa aqdamihim imanan
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: wa aqwamihim bidini allahi
segments.translation: and do not leave for me, in this honored place and glorified shrine, any sin that I did but that You forgive it,

segments.arabic: وَلا تَدَعْ لِي فِي هٰذَا ٱلمَكَانِ ٱلمُكَرَّمِ وَٱلمَشْهَدِ ٱلمُعَظَّمِ ذَنْباً إِلاَّ غَفَرْتَهُ
segments.transliteration: wa ahwatihim `ala al-islami
segments.translation: any care but that You relieve it,

segments.transliteration: ashhadu laqad nasahta lillahi wa lirasulihi wa li'akhika
segments.translation: any illness but that You cure it,

segments.transliteration: fani`ma al-akhu almuwasi
segments.translation: any defect buth that You cover up,

segments.transliteration: fala`ana allahu ummatan qatalatka
segments.translation: any source of sustenance but that You expand it,

segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ummatan zalamatka
segments.translation: any item of terror but that You pacify it,

segments.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu ummatan istahallat minka almaharima
segments.translation: any disunity but that You reunify it,

segments.transliteration: wantahakat hurmata al-islami
segments.translation: any absent one but that You guard it and approach (him to me),

segments.transliteration: fani`ma alssabiru almujahidu
segments.translation: and any single need, among the many needs for this life as well as the life to come

segments.arabic: وَلا حَاجَةً مِنْ حَوَائِجِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
segments.transliteration: almuhami alnnasiru
segments.translation: whose settlement achieves your gratification and my good,

segments.arabic: لَكَ فِيهَا رِضَىٰ وَلِيَ فِيهَا صَلاحٌ
segments.transliteration: wal-akhu alddafi`u `an akhihi
segments.translation: but that You grant it. O He Who is the most merciful of all the merciful ones!

segments.transliteration: almujibu ila ta`ati rabbihi
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O Abuâl-Fadl al-`Abbas the son of the Commander of the Faithful.

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَاَ ٱلفَضْلِ ٱلعَبَّاسَ بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.transliteration: alrraghibu fima zahida fihi ghayruhu min alththwabi aljazili
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the chief of the successors (of the Prophets).

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ سَيِّدِ ٱلْوَصِيِّينَ
segments.transliteration: walththna'i aljamili
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the foremost to Islam,

segments.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ أَوَّلِ ٱلْقَوْمِ إِسْلاَماً
segments.transliteration: wa alhaqaka allahu bidarajati aba'ika fi jannati alnna`imi
segments.translation: the first to believe,

segments.transliteration: allahumma inni ta`arradtu liziyarati awliya'ika raghbatan fi thawabika
segments.translation: the best to have served the religion of Allah,

segments.transliteration: wa raja'an limaghfiratika wa jazili ihsanika
segments.translation: and the most careful for Islam.

segments.transliteration: fa's'aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa alihi alttahirina
segments.translation: I bear witness that you served Allah, His Messenger, and your brother sincerely.

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ لَقَدْ نَصَحْتَ لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلأَخِيكَ
segments.transliteration: wa an taj`ala rizqi bihim darran
segments.translation: You were the most excellent self-sacrificing brother.

segments.transliteration: wa `ayshi bihim qarran
segments.translation: So, Allahâs curse be on the group who killed you.

segments.transliteration: wa ziyarati bihim maqbulatan
segments.translation: Allahâs curse be on the group who wronged you.

segments.transliteration: wa hayati bihim tayyibatan
segments.translation: Allahâs curse be on the group who violated your sanctities

segments.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً ٱسْتَحَلَّتْ مِنْكَ ٱلْمَحَارِمَ
segments.transliteration: wa adrijni idraja almukramina
segments.translation: and infringed the sanctity of Islam.

segments.transliteration: waj`alni mimman yanqalibu min ziyarati mashahidi ahibba'ika
segments.translation: You were the most excellent steadfast fighter,

segments.transliteration: muflihan munjihan
segments.translation: protector, supporter,

segments.transliteration: qad istawjaba ghufrana aldhdhunubi
segments.translation: and brother who defended his brother,

segments.transliteration: wa satra al`uyubi
segments.translation: responded to the obedience to his Lord,

segments.transliteration: wa kashfa alkurubi
segments.translation: and worked desirably for gaining the abundant reward, which others refused,

segments.arabic: ٱلرَّاغِبُ فِيمَا زَهِدَ فِيهِ غَيْرُهُ مِنَ ٱلثَّوَابِ ٱلْجَزِيلِ
segments.transliteration: innaka ahlu alttaqwa wa ahlu almaghfirati
segments.translation: and the nice tribute.

segments.transliteration: astawdi`uka allaha wa astar`ika
segments.translation: So, Allah may attach you to the rank of your fathers in the gardens of bliss.

segments.arabic: وَأَلْحَقَكَ ٱللَّهُ بِدَرَجَةِ آبَائِكَ فِي جَنَّاتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
segments.transliteration: wa aqra'u `alayka alssalama
segments.translation: O Allah, I have done the pilgrimage to Your disciples out of my desire for (winning) your reward

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي تَعَرَّضْتُ لِزِيَارَةِ أَوْلِيَائِكَ رَغْبَةً فِي ثَوَابِكَ
segments.transliteration: amanna billahi wa birasulihi wa bikitabihi
segments.translation: and my wish for Your forgiveness and Your abundant benevolence.

segments.transliteration: wa bima ja'a bihi min `indi allahi
segments.translation: So, I implore You to send Your blessings upon Muhammad and his immaculate Household

segments.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma faktubna ma`a alshshahidina
segments.translation: and to make my sustenance flow copiously in their names,

segments.transliteration: allahumma la taj`alhu akhira al`ahdi min ziyarati qabra ibni akhi rasulika
segments.translation: my living delightful in their names,

segments.transliteration: salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
segments.translation: my pilgrimage rewardable in their names,

segments.transliteration: warzuqni ziyaratahu abadan ma abqaytani
segments.translation: and my life pleasant in their names,

segments.transliteration: wahshurni ma`ahu wa ma`a aba'ihi fi aljinani
segments.translation: to make me take to the conduct of the honored ones,

segments.transliteration: wa `arrif bayni wa baynahu wa bayna rasulika wa awliya'ika
segments.translation: to make me one of those who, as returning from the pilgrimage to the tombs of Your beloved ones,

segments.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْنِي مِمَّنْ يَنْقَلِبُ مِنْ زِيَارَةِ مَشَاهِدِ أَحِبَّائِكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: win success and prosperity

segments.transliteration: wa tawaffani `ala al'imani bika
segments.translation: and deserve forgiveness of sins,

segments.transliteration: walttasdiqi birasulika
segments.translation: covering up of defects,

segments.transliteration: walwilayati li`aliyyi bni abi talibin wal-a'immati min wuldihi
segments.translation: and relief of disasters.

segments.transliteration: walbara'ati min `aduwwihim
segments.translation: You are surely worthy of being feared and worthy of forgiving.

segments.transliteration: fa'inni qad raditu ya rabbi bidhalika
segments.translation: I entrust you with Allah, beseech Him to keep you under His guard,

segments.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: and invoke peace upon you.

segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka yabna amiri almu'minina
segments.translation: We have believed in Allah, in His Messenger, in His Book,

segments.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ayyuha al`abdu alssalihu
segments.translation: and in that which he conveyed from Allah.

segments.arabic: وَبِمَا جَاءَ بِهِ مِنْ عِنْدِ ٱللَّهِ
segments.transliteration: almuti`u lillahi wa lirasulihi
segments.translation: O Allah, record our names with the witnesses.

segments.transliteration: ashhadu annaka qad jahadta wa nasahta
segments.translation: O Allah, do not decide this pilgrimage to the tomb of the son of Your Messengerâs brother to be the last one of mine.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لا تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ ٱلعَهْدِ مِنْ زِيَارَتِي قَبْرَ ٱبْنِ أَخِي رَسُولِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa sabarta hatta ataka alyaqinu
segments.translation: Peace be upon him (i.e. the Messenger) and upon his Household.

segments.transliteration: la`ana allahu alzzalimina lakum min al-awwalina wal-akhirina
segments.translation: Grant me opportunities to visit him so long as You keep me alive,

segments.transliteration: wa alhaqahum bidarki aljahimi
segments.translation: join me to him and to his fathers in the gardens of Paradise,

segments.arabic: وَٱحْشُرْنِي مَعَهُ وَمَعَ آبَائِهِ فِي ٱلْجِنَانِ
segments.translation: and introduce me to him, to Your Messenger, and to Your disciples.

segments.arabic: وَعَرِّفْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ رَسُولِكَ وَأَوْلِيَائِكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, send Your blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: and take me to You while I am abiding by the believing in You,
giving credence to Your Messenger,
being faithful to `Ali the son of Abu-Talib and the Imams from his progeny,

segments.arabic: وَٱلوِلاَيَةِ لِعَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ وَٱلأَئِمَّةِ مِنْ وُلْدِهِ
segments.translation: and disavowing their enemy.
My Lord, I have accepted such.

segments.arabic: فَإِنِّي قَدْ رَضِيتُ يَا رَبِّي بِذٰلِكَ
segments.translation: Allah may send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.

segments.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ امِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be upon you, O righteous servant (of Allah)
and obedient to Allah and to His Messenger.
I bear witness that you strove (in the way of Allah), acted sincerely,
and tolerated (harm) until death came upon you.
May Allah curse those who wronged you from the past and the present generations

segments.arabic: لَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ لَكُمْ مِنَ ٱلاوَّلِينَ وَٱلآخِرِينَ
segments.translation: and may He send them to the lowest layer of the blazing Hell.

"O' Allah, I ask from You the best in Your knowledge, so bless Muhammad and his household and decree for me the best! Inspire us with knowledge to choose the best and make that a means to being pleased with what You have decreed for us and submitting to what You have decided!" Section 2: The Outcome of the Istikhara 4) Divine Inspiration to the Right Path alâImam Jafar alâSadiq (âas), said: "... there is no believing slave (of Allah) who asks the best from Allah one time in his affair, except that He makes a means between the two ways. â 110 Allah, the Glorious and the High is the Purest Perfect Being, and as long as there are no obstacles from the servant's side to prevent His mercy from being manifested, then He will not withhold His blessings and grace. Thus, if a true servant of Allah , with sincerity and a pure heart asks Him for guidance even one time, then without doubt, Allah will guide him towards that which is good and advisable for him. 5) Help in Choosing the Right Path alâImam Jafar alâSadiq (âas), said: "There is no believing slave (of Allah) that asks Allah âthe Glorious and High âfor goodness except that Allah prepares the best for him even if he (the person) does not like it. "2 How unfortunate is it for man that sometimes that which is good for him lies in something that he does not like! Therefore, after one asks the best from Allah , he should not anticipa

segments.arabic:
أَللّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بعِلْمِكَ فَصَلِّ عَلى

    مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ واقْضِ لِي بِالخِيَرَة وَأَلهِمْنا مَعْرِفَة

    الإِختِيار واجْعَلْ ذالِكَ إِلى الرِّضا بِما قَضَيْتَ لِما حَكَمْتَ.

segments.translation: "O' Allah, I ask from You the best in Your knowledge, so bless Muhammad and his household and decree for me the best! Inspire us with knowledge to choose the best and make that a means to being pleased with what You have decreed for us and submitting to what You have decided!"

segments.arabic: (قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُ بِكُمْ رَبِّي لَوْ لاَ دُعَائِكُمْ...)

segments.arabic: بِمَا قَدْ نِيطَتْ بِالْبَرَكَةِ أَعْجَازُهُ وَبَوَادِيهِ،
segments.transliteration: Fakhtir lÄ« AllÄhumma fÄ«hi khÄ«rah,
segments.translation: Then, O Allah, choose for me in it the best of choices,

segments.transliteration: Taruddu shumÅ«sahu dhalÅ«lan, wa taqÊ¿aá¸u ayyÄmahu surÅ«ran,
segments.translation: Making its suns calm and its days filled with joy.

segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma immÄ amrun faâaâtamir, wa immÄ nahyun faâantaihi,
segments.translation: O Allah! If it be a command â then I act upon it,And if it be a prohibition â then I abstain from it.

segments.arabic: تَرُدُّ شُمُوسَهُ ذَلُولًا، وَتَقْعَضُ أَيَّامَهُ سُرُورًا.
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma innÄ« astakhÄ«ruka bi-raá¸¥matika khÄ«ratan fÄ« Ê¿Äfiyah,
segments.translation: O Allah! I seek the best from You, through Your mercy,A choice that brings well-being and ease.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِمَّا أَمْرٌ فَأَئْتَمِرُ، وَإِمَّا نَهْيٌ فَأَنْتَهِي،
اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ خِيَرَةً فِي عَافِيَةٍ.
